jobs.title: Assistent restaurantmanager
jobs.description:
Onze klant is één van de grootste onafhankelijke retailers ter wereld.

De groep heeft een uitgebreid netwerk van vestigingen op internationale markten in Noord-Amerika, Europa en Australië.

Op vandaag is het bedrijf een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van food-to-go bij tankstations.

Onze klant wordt erkend voor zijn investeringsmodel, handelsprestaties en, nog belangrijker, het bieden van de beste ervaring in Retail, Foodservice en Brandstof.

De groep biedt een aantrekkelijk gamma aan erkende wereldmerken (zoals Starbucks, KFC en Burger King) die hun vestigingen omvormen tot een bestemming voor maaltijden en detailhandel die in meerdere behoeften van de klanten voorziet: van koffie over belegde broodjes tot fast food-maaltijden.

Elke dag leveren toegewijde medewerkers onvermoeibaar producten en diensten aan miljoenen klanten en steunen zij de lokale gemeenschappen waarin ze actief zijn.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistent Restaurantmanager bij deze fastfoodketen ben jij de onmisbare rechterhand van de manager en draag je bij aan het dagelijks succes van de vestiging.

Jouw job bestaat uit:

  • het leiden van het team en samen met de collega's voor een klantgerichte werking zorgen
  • een enthousiaste en gemotiveerde sfeer op de werkvloer creëren
  • het opvolgen en streven naar het behalen van de verkoopdoelstellingen
  • nauw samenwerken met de manager, waarbij je rapporteert over de resultaten
  • assisteren bij taken zoals het opstellen van werkroosters, het beheren van de voorraad en het uitvoeren van kassawerkzaamheden
  • inspringen in de keuken of de bediening waar nodig om op die manier een voorbeeldfunctie te bekleden en de voeling met het dagelijks reilen en zeilen van het restaurant te behouden
  • het opnemen van de eindverantwoordelijkheid bij afwezigheid van de manager

Je draagt kortom bij aan de groei van het restaurant door je enthousiasme en klantgerichtheid, en je bent steeds bereid om operationele uitdagingen aan te pakken.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Restaurantmanager herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in horeca
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
  • je werkt graag in een afwisselend uurrooster met werkuren tussen 4u 's ochtends en 23u 's avonds
  • je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, zowel op zaterdag als zondag
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een geboren leider met een passie voor voeding en horeca.

Je hebt zin om te groeien in een leidinggevende functie, waarbij je administratieve taken combineert met operationeel meewerken op de vloer.

Je haalt energie uit een afwisselende job en bent in staat om een team te coachen en aan te sturen. Jij bent een expert in organiseren, delegeren en het nemen van initiatief. Ook onder druk weet je steeds het overzicht te bewaren.

Werken met een variabel uurrooster, inclusief weekends, schrikt jou niet af – integendeel, je geniet van de dynamiek die dit met zich meebrengt.

Je houdt van orde, netheid en zorgt ervoor dat de vestiging er altijd piekfijn uitziet. Je bent nauwkeurig bij het uitvoeren van papier- en kassawerk en weet klanten altijd met een grote glimlach te verwelkomen.

Je volgt samen met de manager de commerciële en financiële resultaten op en bent steeds op zoek naar verbeteringen.

Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Kortom, jij bent een enthousiaste Assistant Restaurantmanager die het verschil maakt.

jobs.title: Skeppare
jobs.description:
Göteborgs universitet möter samhällets utmaningar med mångsidig kunskap. 58 000 studenter och 6800  medarbetare gör universitetet till en stor och inspirerande arbetsplats. Stark forskning och attraktiva utbildningar lockar forskare och studenter från hela världen. Med ny kunskap och nya perspektiv bidrar Göteborgs universitet till en bättre framtid.

Tjärnö marina laboratorium tillsammans med R/V Skagerak ingår i Göteborgs universitets marina infrastruktur. Laboratoriet är beläget en mil utanför Strömstad i norra Bohuslän intill Kosterhavets nationalpark. Det är en stor och modern forskningsstation med olika faciliteter för experimentellt arbete inomhus och utomhus, avancerade laboratorier, ett mindre forskningsfartyg R/V Nereus, ett flertal mindre båtar och undervattensfarkoster, samt undervisningslokaler, kontor och möteslokaler. På stationen finns också en restaurang och logi med kapacitet att ta emot 100 personer, och ett marint akvarium.

Cirka 40 forskare från Göteborgs universitet har sin fasta arbetsplats på Tjärnö, och många forskare från andra universitet i Sverige och utomlands besöker stationen varje år. Förutom forskning är utbildning en stor del av verksamhet på Tjärnö marina laboratorium, och många studenter från Göteborgs universitet, andra universitet och gymnasieskolor kommer till stationen för kortare eller längre vistelse. Samverkan är också en viktig uppgift med ett publikt akvarium, marinbiologiska exkursioner och populärvetenskapliga föreläsningar.

Stationen har teknisk personal på cirka 18 personer som jobbar med olika funktioner som ger stöd och service till forskare och studenter på stationen: tekniker, skeppare, receptionist, kockar, lokalvårdare, samt informatörer och en kommunikatör.



Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer vara skeppare på Nereus och Doris, och tillsammans med övrig besättning ansvara för fartygen, dess framförande och den avancerade provtagningsutrustning som används. Det är viktigt att säkerheten ombord hålls på en hög nivå. Även andra tekniska arbetsuppgifter kan förekomma.

Under de närmaste åren projekterar vi för ett nytt forskningsfartyg som ska ersätta vår 16 m långa Nereus. Som skeppare kommer du vara med i planerings och projekteringsarbete av detta nya fartyg.



Kvalifikationer

Du ska ha Basic safety training, behörighet för fartygsbefäl klass VI, giltigt läkarintyg för sjöfolk, och behörigt ROC-certifikat. Du ska även ha CCM krishanteringsutbildning, utbildning i medical care eller sjukvårdsutbildning för hantering av fartygsapoteket D, och det är meriterande med SSO.

Det är meriterande om du har vana och kunskap av att hantera CTD, olika vattenhämtare, skrapor och huggare.

Som person är du lyhörd för forskningens och utbildningens behov vid provtagning och forskningsuppdrag. Du har en god förmåga att samarbeta med olika yrkeskategorier i en internationell miljö. Arbetsplatsen är svår att nå med hjälp av kollektivtrafiken, underlättar om du har eget fordon.

Arbetet sker framförallt dagtid, men kvälls- och helgarbete förekommer.



Anställning

Tillsvidareanställningen på heltid (100%) med placering på Tjärnö marina laboratorium utanför Strömstad. Provanställning på 6 månader kan komma att tillämpas.

Tillträde för anställningen är snarast möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.



Kontaktuppgifter för anställningen

Har du frågor om anställningen är du välkommen att kontakta oss:

Föreståndare för Tjärnö marina laboratorium Marina Panova, Epost: mailto:marina.panova@marine.gu.se, telefon 076-622 9623 eller

Skeppare Linus Andersson, Epost mailto:linus.andersson@gu.se, telefon 076-622 9690.

Har du frågor om anställningsförfarandet är du välkommen att kontakta Helen Tholander, Epost: mailto:helen.tholander@gu.se, telefon 076-618 3252.



Fackliga organisationer

Fackliga företrädare vid Göteborgs universitet hittar du här: https://www.gu.se/jobba-hos-oss/sa-blir-du-en-av-oss#kollektivavtal-och-fackliga-foretradare



Ansökan

Du söker anställningen via Göteborgs universitets rekryteringsportal genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök". Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett i enlighet med annonsen och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.

Ansökan ska vara inkommen senast: 2026-09-17





Universitetet arbetar aktivt för en arbetsmiljö med jämställda förhållanden och sätter värde på de kvalitéer mångfald tillför verksamheten. Universitetet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Enligt Riksarkivets föreskrifter är universitetet skyldigt att förvara ansökningshandlingar i två år efter tillsättningsbeslutet. Om du som sökande till en anställning särskilt begär tillbaka dina handlingar återsänds de när de två åren har förflutit, i annat fall kommer de att gallras ut. Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Göteborgs universitet anlitar upphandlad annonsbyrå i samband med rekrytering av personal. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

jobs.title: Vil du ha en sentral rolle mellom produksjon, logistikk og leverandører?
jobs.description:
For vår kunde søker vi nå en operativ innkjøper som vil bli en del av et faglig sterkt team med et godt arbeidsmiljø. 

I denne rollen blir du en viktig bidragsyter i den daglige oppfølgingen av innkjøpsaktiviteter knyttet til produksjon. Du vil samarbeide tett med både kollegaer, interne avdelinger og leverandører for å sikre god flyt i prosesser og leveranser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser gjerne at du har erfaring fra innkjøp, enten gjennom en operativ eller koordinerende rolle. Har du erfaring fra andre stillinger med lignende arbeidsoppgaver og samarbeid på tvers av funksjoner, vil vi også gjerne høre fra deg.

Du trives med å arbeide strukturert, følger opp oppgaver på en systematisk måte og evner å samarbeide godt med både kollegaer og leverandører. Samtidig liker du å ta ansvar, kommuniserer godt med mennesker rundt deg og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet. Du motiveres av å samarbeide med ulike mennesker og trives i et miljø hvor samarbeid står sentralt.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Opprette og følge opp innkjøpsordrer
  • Behandle fakturaer og følge opp avvik mot leverandører
  • Følge opp leveranser og bidra til god flyt mellom innkjøp, logistikk og produksjon
  • Bidra til kostnadskontroll, måloppfølging og administrative oppgaver knyttet til innkjøpsfunksjonen
Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Erfaring fra innkjøp eller lignende roller med koordinering, oppfølging og administrasjon
  • God systemforståelse og erfaring med Microsoft Office, spesielt Excel
  • Erfaring med SAP er en fordel
  • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

 

Oppstart: snarest

Varighet: 30.09.2027, med mulighet for forlengelse og fast ansettelse.

 

Ta kontakt med Stian for en uforpliktende prat eller send inn din søknad i dag. Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Personalhuset er et av landets største rekrutterings- og bemanningsselskaper. Vi er en del av Otiga Group - et nordisk konsern bestående av flere selskaper innen rekruttering, bemanning, omstilling og konsulenttjenester. Med våre 20 avdelinger fra nord til sør er vi store nok til å hjelpe, men liten nok til å bry oss. Til sammen er vi over 120 ansatte som hver dag jobber for å inspirere, utfordre og bry oss om våre kunder og medarbeidere. Vi er en nær og personlig rekrutteringspartner og arbeidsgiver. Gjennom effektive leveranser bidrar vi med rett kompetanse slik at våre kunder får løst sine samfunnskritiske oppgaver. Vi jobber for å bidra til økt verdiskapning, inkludering og mangfold i arbeidslivet. Vårt mål er å være ledende i bransjen på mangfold, likestilling og fordomsfri rekruttering. Hver dag jobber vi sammen for å skape fremtidens arbeidsliv - et arbeidsliv som er dynamisk, fleksibelt, fordomsfritt og inkluderende.

jobs.title: Unik mulighet som merkeansvarlig og selger for tre spennende merker!
jobs.description:
Auto 8-8 styrker satsingen i Ålesund

Auto 8-8 styrker satsingen i Ålesund og har gleden av å ansette en merkeansvarlig i en nyopprettet stilling.

Vår nye kollega vil få ansvaret for tre nybilmerker som vi lanserer høsten 2026: Exlantix, Omoda og Jaecoo.

Dette er en svært spennende mulighet for deg som allerede jobber i bilbransjen og ønsker mer fart i hverdagen. Stillingen passer også godt for deg som har lykkes innen andre salgsbransjer og er klar for å ta steget inn i bilbransjen.

 

Om bilmerkene, importøren og produsenten

Du har kanskje ikke hørt om merkene ennå, men internasjonalt er de allerede en del av et av verdens raskest voksende bilkonsern.

Dette er etablerte merker som har vært på markedet over tid, og som nå kommer til Sunnmøre gjennom Auto 8-8.

 

Om Chery-konsernet

Chery er ikke en ny oppstartsbedrift som prøver seg i bilbransjen. Selskapet er Kinas største bileksportør og har bygget millioner av biler gjennom flere tiår.

Mens mange fortsatt ser på kinesiske bilmerker som nykommere, har Chery bygget opp et globalt bilkonsern med egne forsknings- og utviklingssentre i Europa, avanserte elbilplattformer og spennende bilmerker som Exlantix, Jaecoo og Omoda.

I dag konkurrerer konsernet ikke bare på pris, men også på teknologi, kvalitet, sikkerhet og kundeopplevelse. På få år har merkene etablert seg i en rekke europeiske markeder og fått stor oppmerksomhet for sitt design, utstyrsnivå og sin innovative teknologi.

 

Felles for alle merkene
  • 5 av 5 stjerner i Euro NCAP
  • 7 års / 150.000 km nybilgaranti
  • RSA er norsk importør og samarbeidspartner
  • RSA har over 90 års erfaring med bilimport, hovedkontor i Drammen og leverer årlig rundt 15.000 biler til det norske markedet
  • Solid ettermarked med delelager både i Europa og Norge
  • Flere nye og attraktive modeller lanseres i nær fremtid

Dette er en unik mulighet til å bli med helt fra starten og bygge opp tre spennende bilmerker i markedet på Sunnmøre. For den rette kandidaten ligger det store muligheter til å påvirke, skape resultater og bli en sentral del av en offensiv satsing i årene som kommer.

 

 

Kort om merkene

Exlantix
Chery-konsernets premiummerke. Exlantix kombinerer avansert teknologi, høy sikkerhet, imponerende ytelser og moderne design med en pris som utfordrer de etablerte premiummerkene. Bilene produseres ved Cherys toppmoderne produksjonsanlegg i Changshu, Kina, hvor høy grad av automatisering og robotteknologi bidrar til jevn og høy kvalitet.

Omoda og Jaecoo
To av Europas raskest voksende bilmerker. Merkene kombinerer moderne design, avansert teknologi, høy sikkerhet og et omfattende utstyrsnivå til en svært konkurransedyktig pris. På kort tid har de etablert seg i rundt 20 europeiske markeder og oppnådd sterk vekst i blant annet Storbritannia, Spania og Italia.

Omoda retter seg mot kunder som ønsker innovasjon, design og digital teknologi i hverdagen, mens Jaecoo kombinerer premiumfølelse, komfort og robuste SUV-egenskaper. Felles for begge merkene er ambisjonen om å tilby biler som utfordrer etablerte aktører på kvalitet, teknologi og kundeopplevelse.

Som et tydelig tegn på Chery-konsernets langsiktige satsing i Europa er det også inngått planer om lokal produksjon ved Nissans fabrikk i Sunderland, England, fra 2027.

 

Dine arbeidsoppgaver

Hos oss får du en variert og hektisk hverdag, der du vil spille en nøkkelrolle i vår offensive satsing på Exlantix, Omoda og Jaecoo.

  • Være merkeansvarlig og vår interne ekspert på Exlantix, Omoda og Jaecoo.
  • Bidra til et godt samarbeid med importør
  • Sørge for god synlighet og implementering av merkevarene i markedet i samarbeid med markedsavdelingen.
  • Salg og innkjøp av nye og brukte biler til privat- og bedriftskunder.
  • Sikre at bilutstilling, materiell og øvrige merke elementer alltid holder høy standard.
  • Gi kundene en profesjonell og minneverdig kundeopplevelse gjennom hele kjøpsprosessen.
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre kundeaktiviteter, lanseringer, messer og lokale markedsaktiviteter.
  • Bidra i budsjettarbeid, oppfølging av resultater og lønnsomhetsutvikling for merkene.

  • Følge opp lanseringer av nye modeller og bidra til videre vekst for satsingen.

     

Vi ser etter deg som:
  • Har stor arbeidskapasitet og synes det er både motiverende og givende å være på jobb.
  • Er ærlig, tillitvekkende og profesjonell i møte med kunder, kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Er en god lytter og evner å forstå kundens behov.
  • Har interesse for bil, teknologi og salg.
  • Har salgserfaring fra bilbransjen eller andre salgsorienterte roller, og kan vise til gode resultater.
  • Trives med å skape relasjoner og bygge tillit over tid.
  • Ser verdien av et godt arbeidsmiljø og bidrar positivt til laget.
  • Er selvgående, strukturert og tar ansvar for egne resultater.
  • Har gjennomføringsevne og “stayerevne”
  • Har førerkort klasse B.

 

Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
  • Du får en sentral rolle i lanseringen og utviklingen av tre spennende bilmerker med stort vekstpotensial på Sunnmøre.
  • Du blir en del av et svært godt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og erfarne kollegaer som ønsker at du skal lykkes.
  • Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser med en solid fastlønn og gode muligheter til å påvirke egen inntekt gjennom egne og avdelingens resultater.
  • Du får hele Auto 8-8-laget i ryggen, med sterke støttefunksjoner innen salg, marked, ettermarked og administrasjon.
  • Gode muligheter for kompetanseutvikling gjennom kurs, opplæring og tett samarbeid med importør og fabrikk.
  • Karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter i et konsern med ambisjoner og langsiktig satsing.
  • Tilgang til firmabilordning, fri telefon, bilvask og attraktive ansattbetingelser på produkter og tjenester.
  • Gratis trening gjennom Sporty-kjeden.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Hos Auto 8-8 får du muligheten til å være med på noe nytt, samtidig som du har tryggheten, kompetansen og ressursene til en veletablert virksomhet i ryggen.

 

 

NB!  Søknader vurderes fortløpende, og vi forbeholder oss retten til å ansette aktuell kandidat før søknadsfristens utløp. Vi oppfordrer derfor interesserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig.

 

 

Kraft møter presisjon | Exlantix

Designet for eventyr | Omoda Jaecoo

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Auto 8-8 har 9 og 3 under forhandlere, -fra Bodø i Nord til Førde i sørvest. 

Avdelingen i Ålesund ble etablert i 1938 og er den største butikken i forhandlerkjeden. 

På avdelingen i Ålesund fører vi fra høsten 2026 bilmerkene Ford, Nissan, Hyundai, Mazda, Seres, Exlantix, Jaecoo og Omoda. 

Vi er en “one stop shop” forhandler som tilbyr salg av nye og brukte biler, service, vedlikehold og reparasjoner, ruteskift, dekk og dekkhotell, karosseri avdeling, delesalg, vasketjenester mm. 

Totalt i Auto 8-8 er vi ca 370 ansatte, herav ca 75 i Ålesund og vi er stadig i vekst.

jobs.title: Soltun barnehage SA søker Barne- og ungdomsarbeider i vikariat
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Consultant CRM (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir stellen uns vor!

Seit über 25 Jahren beraten und begleiten wir KMUs bei der Digitalisierung von Unternehmensprozessen, um Kundenbeziehungen effizient und erfolgreich zu gestalten. Mit unserer Erfahrung von 300 aktiv betreuten Firmenkunden und 11.000 Usern in mehreren Branchen wissen wir, dass der nachhaltige Erfolg von CRM- und CPQ-Initiativen aus dem optimalen Zusammenspiel dreier entscheidender Faktoren resultiert: Menschen, Prozesse und Lösungen (mpl).

Unsere Kunden verlassen sich stets auf unsere Zuverlässigkeit, unser Knowhow und unsere Präzision. Optimaler Service hat immer erste Priorität. Zusammenarbeit, Teamgeist, Vertrauen, Engagement mit Begeisterung zeichnet unsere tägliche Arbeit aus. Wenn Dir diese Faktoren genauso wichtig sind, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Wir suchen Mitarbeiter:innen, die innovativ und zielorientiert die Zusammenarbeit intern wie extern gestalten und fördern.

Verstärke unser Team als CRM-Consultant und arbeite mit uns an dieser Mission.

Aufgaben

Als CRM-Consultant bist du maßgeblich daran beteiligt, die Kundenprozesse unserer mittelständischen Kunden durch innovative CRM-Lösungen zu optimieren. In spannenden Projekten arbeitest du daran, Unternehmen bei der Digitalisierung und erfolgreichen Gestaltung ihrer Kundenbeziehungen zu unterstützen.

Bereits vor dem ersten Kundentermin analysierst du die grundlegenden Anforderungen und entwickelst auf dieser Basis individuelle Lösungskonzepte. Du erarbeitest zusammen mit den Kunden passgenaue Strategien und setzt diese in die Konfiguration und Implementierung moderner CRM-Systeme um.

Du stehst unseren Kunden als kompetente Ansprechperson zur Seite, moderierst Workshops und führst Schulungen durch, um eine eigenständige Nutzung der Systeme zu gewährleisten. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass Prozesse nahtlos ineinandergreifen und die Systeme optimal in die bestehende IT-Landschaft integriert werden.

Zusätzlich unterstützt du bei der Erstellung von Vertriebsdemos und Aufwandsschätzungen, um zukünftige Projekte erfolgreich zu gestalten. Auch nach dem Projektabschluss bleibst du der verlässliche Partner für Erweiterungen und Optimierungen.

Qualifikation

  • Dein Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung bildet die Basis für deine Expertise.
  • Du hast erste Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von CRM- oder ERP-Projekten – in der Beratung oder inhouse.
  • Mit deinem ausgeprägten Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und IT-Systeme kannst du Kundenanforderungen schnell analysieren und innovative Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Deine Arbeitsweise ist strukturiert, zielorientiert und geprägt von Teamgeist.
  • Du bist kommunikativ, serviceorientiert und arbeitest gerne eng mit Kunden zusammen.
  • Für Workshops und Projektmeetings bist du bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu sein.

Benefits

  • Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie regelmäßige Weiterbildungen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
  • Attraktive Homeoffice Regelungen
  • Abwechslungsreiche und herausfordernde Kundenprojekte in unterschiedlichen Branchen
  • Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsplätze
  • Attraktives Grundgehalt mit zusätzlichen Provisionen
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über Unterstützungskasse
  • Weitere Corporate Benefits wie bspw. Rabatte auf Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Bist du bereit, diese interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe zu übernehmen und mit uns zu wachsen? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des möglichen Eintrittstermins.

jobs.title: Partner & Projektmanager Fußballmarketing (m/w/d) | Duales Studium MA
jobs.description:

Aufgaben

**Deine Rolle:
**
Du studierst im Master und unterstützt bei der Betreuung unserer Partner und der Umsetzung von Projekten. Von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Reporting bringst du Partner und Team zusammen.

Ab dem ersten Tag geben wir dir Verantwortung und du wächst Schritt für Schritt in die Rolle hinein - mitten im Fußballmarketing.

Deine Aufgaben bei uns:

  • Du steuerst Sponsoring-Aktivierungen von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis zum finalen Reporting.
  • Du betreust unsere Partner im Tagesgeschäft und bist ihre feste Ansprechperson.
  • Du koordinierst Kreation, Projektmanagement und Produktion und behältst Budgets und Deadlines im Blick.
  • Du entwickelst Angebote und Präsentationen und wirkst im Neugeschäft mit, von der Recherche bis zum Projektabschluss.
  • Du begleitest Termine und Produktionen vor Ort beim Partner.
  • Du verfolgst das Fußballbusiness sowie Sponsoring-Trends und bringst Impulse in laufende Projekte.
  • Du nutzt KI für Research, Dokumentation und die Vorbereitung von Präsentationen und machst daraus bessere Abläufe.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast deinen Bachelor erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Sponsoring oder Vertrieb.
  • Fußball ist mehr als nur ein Hobby für dich: Du verstehst, was Fans, Vereine und Marken bewegt, und brennst dafür, in dieser Welt zu arbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, kommunizierst klar und bringst kreative Ideen bei Projekten ein.
  • Du kommst mit Keynote oder PowerPoint, Tabellen, Google Workspace und unserem CRM-Tool close zurecht; Erfahrung mit ClickUp oder sevDesk sind ein Plus.
  • Du arbeitest bereits mit KI-Tools und willst darin besser werden.
  • Du willst nach dem Studium mehr können als davor und dafür früh Verantwortung übernehmen.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Wir übernehmen deine gesamten Studiengebühren.
  • Du startest mit einem vergüteten Kennenlernpraktikum vor dem Studienstart.
  • Du arbeitest an realen Projekten für Partner wie DFB, UEFA, Mewa, Bitburger, Puma und fritz-kola.
  • Du übernimmst ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung für eigene Themen.
  • Du erhältst vielfältige Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten, um dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest in unserem Loftbüro in Hamburg-Eimsbüttel, zwischen Volkspark und Millerntor.

Du erkennst dich in der Rolle wieder und brennst für Fußball? Dann schreib uns.

Vi söker inte bara någon som kan städa. Vi söker en person som vill bli en del av vårt team, tar ansvar för sina kunder och tycker att god service och ett trevligt bemötande är lika viktigt som ett väl utfört arbete.

Vi uppskattar medarbetare som ser vad som behöver göras, hjälper till när det behövs och vill utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.

Hos oss är du inte bara någon som fyller ett arbetspass – du representerar Wernamo Bemanning & Allservice AB ute hos våra kunder och är en viktig del av vårt företags ansikte utåt.

Är du noggrann, serviceinriktad och tycker om att skapa rena och trivsamma miljöer?

﻿Nu söker vi en engagerad och flexibel lokalvårdare till vårt team i Värnamo.

Hos Wernamo Bemanning & Allservice AB får du ett varierande arbete där kvalitet, ansvar och god service står i centrum. Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta självständigt, möta olika kunder och vill ha ett deltidsarbete på ca 34 %.

Arbetstiderna varierar och tidiga morgnar förekommer. I tjänsten ingår även arbete varannan lördag. Eftersom vi behöver kunna hjälpa våra kunder även när ordinarie personal blir sjuk söker vi dig som har möjlighet att vara flexibel och ibland hoppa in med kort varsel.

B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil är ett absolut krav för tjänsten.

Tidigare erfarenhet av lokalvård är meriterande, men vi värdesätter framför allt rätt inställning, arbetsvilja, ansvarskänsla och god service.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du en stabil arbetsplats med varierande arbetsdagar och eget ansvar. Vi erbjuder marknadsmässig lön, OB-ersättning och milersättning.

jobs.title: SAP Application Expert, in SAP Transportation Management System
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an SAP Application Expert, you will be responsible for configuring, testing, and supporting SAP Transportation Management (TM) solutions across transportation planning, execution, freight costing, and settlement processes. The role requires solid functional expertise in transportation management processes, master data configuration, integration testing, defect analysis, and business support throughout implementation, rollout, and hyper care phases.

Key Skills and Responsibilities that are part of your daily work

    Configure and maintain SAP TM master data, including locations, business partners, carriers, transportation zones, lanes, resources, and freight agreements.
    Configure and support transportation demand management, including Freight Unit Building Rules (FUBR), transportation requirements, and demand consolidation.
    Configure and test transportation planning processes, including freight unit planning, carrier assignment, route determination, consolidation, and Freight Order creation.
    Configure and support Freight Order lifecycle management, transportation execution, status management, and shipment tracking processes.
    Configure freight charge management, including rate tables, calculation sheets, freight agreements, surcharges, and freight cost calculation.
    Configure and support freight settlement processes, including Freight Settlement Documents (FSD), cost allocation, invoice verification, and financial integration.
    Support carrier onboarding, tendering processes, and carrier collaboration activities.
    Perform functional testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect analysis, and validation of end-to-end transportation processes.
    Support integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM, SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), and SAP GTT where applicable.
    Analyse and resolve production issues, support business users, and participate in cutover, deployment, and hyper care activities.
    Prepare functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will work with a team of highly skilled professionals on H&M Group’s advanced SAP platform, which supports operations worldwide. The role offers plenty of room for learning, development, and participation in various initiatives. Together we stive to achieve end to end visibility of our Transport & Trade flows to enable proactive, data-driven decision making.

Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE

Your mindset and skills

We believe you bring solid experience in the SAP Transportation Management area, with solid knowledge of system design, concepts, principles, and configuration. You are confident in explaining SAP Transportation Management (TM)-related topics to both team members and stakeholders across the H&M Group.

You are confident in working independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

You are self-driven, proactive and take accountability with analytic mindset.  

You have excellent communication skills so that you can communicate information clearly and effectively.

Mandatory requirements, both competence and tools:

    Solid hands-on SAP TM configuration experience (7+ years).
    Proficiency in Freight Unit Management, Transportation Planning, Freight Order Management, Freight Charge Management, Freight Settlement and SAP TM Master Data configuration.
    Proficiency in end-to-end transportation processes, including inbound, outbound and Transit.
    Proven experience in supporting carrier onboarding, tendering processes, and carrier collaboration activities.
    Proven experience in writing functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation.
    Proven experience in SIT/UAT execution, defect management, and business process validation, including integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM and SAP BN4L,  
    Strong ability to communicate SAP TM topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the H&M Group.
    Experience with SAP transport and change management tools, such as STMS, Solution Manager, and ActiveControl.
    Experience in developing WRICEF objects (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from a functional point of view.

Additional beneficial competences:

    Experience working in global SAP rollout and transformation programs.
    ABAP
    Fiori Development

Language Skills:

    Fluent in English.

Additional Information

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

    Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
    Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
    Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market.
    30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance.
    Additional perks and discounts from Benify.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.

Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. ​We are eager to meet you!

jobs.title: Er du en engasjert, motivert og relasjonsskapende voksen som vil bidra til barns livsglede og mestring?
jobs.description:
Gausetangen barnehage er en av Holmestrands 7 kommunale barnehager og er den eneste barnehagen under fjellet i sentrum. Gausetangen er en 6 avdelings barnehage som sto ferdig i mars 2020. Barnehagen har et funksjonelt og tilrettelagt bygg med tilhørende utelekeplass. Barnehagen ligger i gangavstand til både sentrum, sjøen og naturområder som gir oss ulike opplevelser og erfaringer vi tar flittig i bruk.

I Holmestrand har vi et helhetlig og sammenhengende arbeid i hele oppvekst og arbeider for tidlig innsats og inkludering av alle barn i sterke fellesskap.

Vår visjon er: «Trygghet, mestring og læring for alle»

Profesjonsutvikling for alle ansatte er en viktig del i satsningen og vi samarbeider om utviklingsarbeidet vårt med Universitetet i sørøst Norge.  

Vi har følgende ledig stillinger i Gausetangen barnehage:

  • 100 % vikariat som barnehagelærer fra og med oktober 2026 til og med 13 desember 2026. 
Arbeidsoppgaver:
  • Aktiv deltakelse i barnehagens mål og utviklingsarbeid
  • Bidra til et pedagogisk godt omsorgs- og læringsmiljø
  • Skape gode og leke- og læringsarenaer
  • Medansvar for organisering og samarbeid i hele barnehagen
  • Ivareta et godt samarbeid med foresatte og andre samarbeidspartnere
Krav til kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent utdanning som barnehagelærer/ førskolelærer
  • Praksis fra barnehage vektlegges 
  • Erfaring fra, og interesse for barn med spesielle behov, samt flerkulturelle familier er en fordel
  • Søkere må kunne beherske relevante dataverktøy
  • Gyldig politiattest må forevises
Personlig egenskaper
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner muntlig og skriftlig
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å arbeide reflektert og selvstendig
  • Engasjert, kreativ og løsningsorientert
  • Har evnen til å møte hvert enkelt barn ut ifra sine forutsetninger og behov
  • Evne til å tenke helhetlig rundt barns oppvekstmiljø
  • Evner til planlegging, gjennomføring, vurdering og dokumentasjon som "beveger" praksis
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Veiledning til nyansatte
  • Oppfølging og støtte til nyansatte i engasjerte fagmiljøer
  • Varierte og spennende utfordringer ifht barnehagens mål
  • Kompetanseheving i egen barnehage og mulighet for relevant etter – og videreutdanning

Lønn i henhold til avtaler/tariff. Medlemskap i pensjonsordning og gode personalforsikringer. Fra lønnen trekkes 2% innskudd til pensjonsordning. Arbeidstakere ansettes i kommunen på de vilkår og med de rettigheter og plikter som følger av overenskomster, reglementer og lover.

Kommunen er opptatt av mangfold og vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming og nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn. Vi er en IA-virksomhet og jobber sammen for et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

Søkerlister med opplysninger om navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosted- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker er offentlig i hht Offentlighetsloven. Det kan gjøres unntak dersom søker anmoder om dette og grunngir i dette i søknaden. Dersom anmodning ikke tas til følge, vil søker varsles om dette.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Holmestrand kommune har ca. 27 000 innbyggere og ca. 1 800 årsverk. Kommunen ligger vakkert til med lang kystlinje, flott natur, innsjø, elver, skog og fjell. Jernbanen og E18 går gjennom kommunen og gir god kommunikasjon både nordover og sørover. Holmestrand kommune er en næringsoffensiv kommune og i sterk vekst med økende innbyggertall. Holmestrand kommune er porten til Vestfold, og er et attraktivt sted å bo, besøke og drive næringsvirksomhet.

jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What you will do

jobs.title: Billing Manager
jobs.description:
Billing Manager

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)


Our Mission For You
Own the invoicing engine of a hyper-growth energy-tech company. Your work directly protects our cash flow and keeps our growth engine running. Invoicing directly affects our cash flow in the millions. This role is a lever, not a cost center.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth company with strong team growth, rising invoice volumes, and increasing complexity per invoice. Individual contracts, PPAs, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes: every customer segment is a small puzzle. Today, that puzzle is solved mostly manually, and it needs to move to the next level.

You'll build order out of that complexity. You'll jump into individual invoices when it matters. At the same time, you'll design the process that makes those individual jumps unnecessary. You'll be part of our Billing Tool Rollout and help prepare invoicing for our ERP migration. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own the operation, not just manage it.


What You'll Own

Own Invoicing End to End

  • Own daily invoicing processes to trawa customers: quality, completeness, timing

  • Reduce and eliminate our current ticket backlog through prioritization, root-cause analysis, and systematic execution

  • Ensure complex billing logic (PPA, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes) is correctly reflected in every invoice

  • Own the invoicing KPIs: on-time rate, error rate, ticket aging, time-to-invoice

Build Scalable Processes

  • Be part of designing and rolling out a scalable invoicing architecture, from today's manual setup to a standardized and automated solution

  • Automate recurring process steps

  • Document everything: reproducible, hand-off-ready, audit-ready

Stakeholder & Customer Communication

  • Direct customer communication on invoicing questions, in writing (German and English)

  • Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to secure upstream data quality (contracts, prices, delivery points)

  • Partner closely with our Tech/Data team, where consumption data, time series, and energy accruals are your input

  • Establish escalation paths and priority logic with Sales and CS, so edge cases don't block the standard process

Data Quality & Handover to Accounting

  • Ensure invoicing data flows cleanly into accounting, as the interface to our accounting team

  • Contribute to month-end close: clean invoicing cut-off, documented open items, accruals-relevant data ready on time

  • Audit-readiness from an invoicing perspective: process documentation, invoice-level traceability, controls


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years in Billing, Order-to-Cash, Finance Operations, or similar operational Finance roles

  • Scale-up experience, with at least one station at a fast-growing company. You've worked without a clean ERP, with ambiguous processes, in a team being built as it runs

  • B2B billing with complex pricing models, not SaaS flat-rate. You've handled individual contracts, volume-based logic, or formula-driven pricing

  • Proven high-output track record. You've personally delivered and you can point to a moment where you built or saved a critical process

  • Systems thinker with a detail obsession. You see the pattern behind ticket or invoice corrections

  • Excel/ Sheets power user. You build models others can't unpack, and you document them so they can

  • Strong stakeholder management

  • Ownership mindset. You take things on without asking whether it's "in your role"

  • Business fluent in English and German (written); speaking is a big plus

Nice-to-haves

  • Energy or utility experience

  • Hands-on experience with a Billing Tool rollout or ERP implementation

  • SQL, Python basics, or hands-on experience with AI tools (Claude, Langdock, n8n)

Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Land & Understand

  • Understand our business model, the German energy market basics, and our billing complexity. Understand what drives our corrections rate. Build relationships with the most important stakeholders.

Month 2: Stabilize

  • Keep invoicing running stably while spotting optimization opportunities. Define clear ticket priorities and escalation paths with Sales and CS. Ship first quick wins in automation and process design. Define and start tracking your KPIs: error rate, ticket aging.

Month 3: Build

  • Deliver a target process architecture for improvements to our current invoicing processes. Actively and proactively reduce time-to-invoice and corrections rates. Present your automation and process roadmap to the finance leadership team.

Why trawa?

  • Real ownership from day one. You build the invoicing function that unlocks trawa's growth

  • Direct collaboration in a complex stakeholder set-up, with direct contact to our finance leadership team

  • A uniquely complex problem space at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance

  • An AI-first Finance team that embraces new tools and ways of working

  • Accelerated career growth in a scaling environment with massive scope

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant office culture


Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We value ownership, learning speed, and aren't hunger over a perfect CV.

jobs.title: Regional Director of Sales
jobs.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Regional Director of Enterprise Sales, you act as the primary catalyst for RobCo's enterprise growth across the German market, driving large-scale industrial adoption of our Autonomous Manufacturing Platform. You will lead high-impact sales strategies, build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders in key industrial sectors, and scale our enterprise footprint from the ground up.

Your Responsibilities

  • Drive Regional Revenue: Lead and execute the German enterprise sales strategy to achieve and exceed ambitious revenue and market-penetration targets.

  • Build Executive Relationships: Target, engage, and secure long-term partnerships with C-level executives and key decision-makers across mid-market and large-scale manufacturing and industrial enterprises.

  • Champion Technical Solutions: Direct complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles by clearly communicating the strategic, financial, and technical ROI of RobCo's modular robotics and physical AI solutions.

  • Scale Enterprise Footprint: Identify and unlock new market verticals and geographic opportunities across the DACH region to continually expand the sales pipeline.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Solution Engineering and Product teams to align client requirements with product capabilities and deliver seamless rollouts.

  • Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene, actionable sales reporting, and highly accurate quarterly/annual revenue forecasts in Salesforce.

  • Represent the Brand: Position RobCo as the premier AI-driven automation provider through representation at key industry events, panel discussions, and executive roundtables.

  • Team Leadership & Enablement: Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing team of Senior Account Executives, driving quota attainment, pipeline growth, and continuous performance management.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management, or comparable experience.

  • Proven track record of sales leadership, with demonstrated success enabling Senior Account Executives to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.

  • Several years of experience in Enterprise SaaS or Hardware/Robotics Sales, specifically closing complex, high-value B2B deals within the German industrial or manufacturing sectors.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding enterprise sales quotas ($2M+ ARR responsibility) and managing complex, multi-month deal cycles.

  • Deep understanding of industrial automation, manufacturing workflows, or Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) models.

  • Willingness to travel up to 50-75% within Germany for client meetings, trade shows, onsite evaluations, and international team offsites.

  • Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership mindset, high drive for results, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Om rollen

Shape the future of energy.  

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee –Strategy & Business advisor

Business Area (BA) Generation is responsible for Vattenfall’s nuclear and hydropower operations. Our mission is to maximize business opportunities while contributing to a reliable, efficient, and environmentally sustainable energy system.

Our staff function Fleet Development within BA Generation, is responsible for strategic planning, optimization of our generation assets, business unit support and follow-up, and business development activities.

This includes conducting analyses, developing strategies, driving strategic processes, and pursuing business and development opportunities. We also monitor the progress of BA Generation’s objectives, track external developments, and perform benchmarking activities.

Your responsibilities:

    Take part in analyses and strategy development to support future business decisions and goals, helping translate technical, operational and business insights into recommendations
    Take part in business oversight activities, supporting our business units in their efforts to improve performance and deliver long-term value.

Kravspecifikation

As a Trainee - Strategy & Business advisor you recognize yourself in the following:

    Master of Sience in Engineering or Business and Economics
    You have a strategic and analytical mindset, being able to take in and analyze complex and sometimes contradictory information.
    You are a strong team player who works effectively across teams and stakeholder groups, building trust and creating alignment to achieve shared objectives.
    You are action oriented and enjoying taking on and deliver on new opportunities and challenges.
    You are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, German is a merit

Whether you aspire to a climate smarter career as an energy specialist, visionary manager, or inspirational project lead, we offer these opportunities within our Trainee Programme.

As Cato, our International Trainee in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

    Be a recent graduate with an academic degree or expected graduation before March 2027.
    Have maximum one year of work experience.
    Be fluent in Swedish and English. Skills in other languages can be a merit.
    Be willing to relocate for possible assignments throughout the organization.
    Identify with our principles: active, open, positive and safety.

Location:

You will be working in the department Performance Optimization within Staff Function Fleet Development and located in Solna, Sweden.

Ytterligare information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.  

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations. Each position comes with a competitive salary and excellent remuneration package. Read more about the elements of the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme here.

Application process

We welcome your application in English via the application button on this page. Please include an updated resume. When applying, you will fill out screening questions, including your motivation. No cover letter or motivation letter is needed. The deadline to apply is October 18th, 2026. Selection will start after the application period with online tests, followed by interviews between the end of October to end November. We kindly ask you to use the same email address during the whole process (application and online test) otherwise there is a risk that your application is excluded due to system reasons. .

jobs.title: International Trainee - Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee – Environmental Specialist

You will join Waste & Environment West, a team that supports Vattenfall's businesses with environmental expertise across hydropower, nuclear power, new nuclear, wind power and heat. In this role, you will contribute to environmental assessments, permitting activities and environmental coordination in projects and operational activities. You will collaborate with environmental specialists, project teams, technical experts and authorities, while gradually taking on more responsibility as your knowledge grows. This is an opportunity to develop your expertise in environmental management and environmental legislation while bringing a fresh perspective to the environmental challenges connected to the energy transition.

Your responsibilities:

    Support environmental specialists with environmental matters in projects and operational activities across several of Vattenfall's business areas.
    Contribute to environmental assessments, environmental plans, permit processes and environmental documentation.
    Help review environmental legislation and regulatory requirements.
    Participate in environmental coordination, environmental risk assessments and chemical-related matters.
    Collaborate with colleagues, specialists and authorities across different energy technologies.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Environmental Specialist

    Academic background in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering or a related field.
    Basic knowledge of environmental legislation, permitting processes, regulatory requirements or environmental management.
    Experience of environmental matters in projects, permitting processes or interaction with authorities is considered an advantage. This experience may have been gained through a thesis project, internship, student employment or an early-career role.
    Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

You should also recognize yourself in

    Enjoying collaboration with colleagues from different disciplines and building strong relationships across teams and stakeholders
    Being comfortable navigating changing priorities and new challenges
    Working in a structured and careful way when handling documentation, environmental requirements and stakeholder communication
    Being curious and motivated by learning how environmental considerations are applied across different energy technologies.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location: Gothenburg or Ringhals

You will be working in the Waste & Environment West team at Business Unit Vattenfall Power Solutions, located in Gothenburg and Ringhals, Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations.

jobs.title: Vil du bli en i mitt team?
jobs.description:
En BPA ordning skal bidra til å gi mennesker med assistansebehov muligheten til å leve et aktivt og mest mulig uavhengig liv. Med en BPA ordning er det bruker eller medarbeidsleder som organiserer, og leder det daglige arbeidet i tett samarbeid med Holmestrand kommunen som er arbeidsgiver.

Om stillingen

Jeg er en mann i 40 åra som søker BPA assistenter. Hos meg vil du få variert arbeid, alt fra husarbeid, personlig stell, lage mat og ulike andre aktiviteter jeg har behov for at du tilrettelegger eller utfører. Jeg har behov for at du kan jobbe selvstendig, og er praktisk anlagt og vant til å holde en husholdning i orden sammen med meg. Arbeidsdagen blir en blanding av rutine, og kunne ta ting på sparket.

Arbeidstid: morgen, kveld og helger

Krav til kvalifikasjoner

Utdanning er ingen forutsetning

  • God norsk muntlig kommunikasjonsevne
  • Førerkort klasse B helst med manuell gir
  • Det må fremvises gyldig politiattest før oppstart i.h.h.t lov om helsepersonell 
Dine oppgaver vil blant annet være:
  • Tilrettelegging og veiledning i daglige gjøremål
  • Motivasjon og støtte i aktiviteter og rutiner
  • Matlaging etter fast matplan
  • Bistand og veiledning ved personlig hygiene
Personlige egenskaper
  • Være pålitelig
  • Vise engasjement og initiativ
  • Utholdenhet og tålmodighet
  • Sporty og aktiv
  • Fleksibel

Personlig egnethet vektlegges

Vi tilbyr
  • Lønn i henhold til avtale/tariff
  • Medlemskap i god pensjonsordning. Fra lønnen trekkes 2% innskudd til pensjonsordning. Arbeidstakere ansettes i kommunen på de vilkår og med de rettigheter og plikter som følger av overenskomster, reglementer og lover.

Attester og vitnemål tas med ved et eventuelt intervju.

Kommunen er opptatt av mangfold og vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn. Vi er en IA-virksomhet og jobber sammen for et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

Søkerlister med opplysninger om navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosted- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker er offentlig i hht Offentlighetsloven. Det kan gjøres unntak dersom søker anmoder om dette og grunngir dette i søknaden. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge vil søkeren varsles om dette.

Kontaktpersoner:

Medarbeidsleder: Linn-Terese Orsteen Sandum. Mobil: 476 77 376

BPA-konsulent: Hilde Iversen mobil: 478 50 155

 


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Holmestrand kommune har ca. 27 000 innbyggere og ca. 1 800 årsverk. Kommunen ligger vakkert til med lang kystlinje, flott natur, innsjø, elver, skog og fjell. Jernbanen og E18 går gjennom kommunen og gir god kommunikasjon både nordover og sørover. Holmestrand kommune er en næringsoffensiv kommune og i sterk vekst med økende innbyggertall. Holmestrand kommune er porten til Vestfold, og er et attraktivt sted å bo, besøke og drive næringsvirksomhet.

    Knowledge of data analysis, statistics, optimisation, modelling or simulation
    Experience from programming or analytical tools, for example Python

jobs.title: Customer Service English–Polish–German
jobs.description:
Our client is a European transport company specialising in the hire of plastic pallets.


Jobomschrijving

Do you enjoy problem-solving, adapting to new situations and communicating with people from different countries? Then we have a great challenge for you!

We are looking for a motivated Customer Service Assistant for an innovative transport company in Schelle (Antwerp) who can communicate fluently in English, Polish and German.

You’ll be a key link within the logistics department. Working with various partners and sites, you’ll ensure that return shipments are collected smoothly, efficiently and on time. No two days are the same: you’ll plan, coordinate, follow up and step in when things don’t go to plan.

Your mission?

To ensure that every collection runs as smoothly as possible. You’ll maintain an overview, liaise with the relevant parties and spot potential issues before they become real problems.

In practical terms, this means that you:

• Plan and organise collections by creating weekly schedules and maintaining contact with the relevant partners and locations.

• Actively track which locations have not yet been contacted and ensure that no collection slips through the net.

• Monitor performance and help devise solutions when a collection does not go to plan.

• Keep customer details up to date, from telephone numbers and email addresses to opening hours and other practical information.

• Continuously look for smart ways to increase the success rate of collections.

Can you tick off the following points? Then you’re the Customer Service we’re looking for!

  • • You’re multilingual. You communicate fluently in English, Polish and German and feel at ease in an international working environment.
  • Transport and logistics appeal to you. Experience is a bonus, but not essential. Your motivation, eagerness to learn and interest in the sector are just as important.
  • You’re curious and keen to learn. You pick up new information quickly and have an interest in transport and logistics.
  • You like structure. You work in an organised manner and ensure your records are kept clearly, transparently and efficiently.
  • You take the initiative. You don’t always wait for someone to tell you what needs doing, but contribute your own ideas and aren’t afraid to take action.
  • You’re confident and self-assured. Even when things don’t go to plan, you stay calm, focus on solutions and aren’t afraid to make decisions.
  • You’re a real team player. You enjoy working with others, help colleagues where needed and bring a positive vibe to the team with your energy.
  • You have your own transport and can get to Schelle with ease.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment


CONTACT

Discover more about METYCLE:

About us | LinkedIn

We look forward to receiving your application. Irene Prinz is happy to answer any questions you may have: +49 152 34 62 72 85.
