jobs.title: Säljare Linköping
jobs.description:
Riddermark Bil är Sveriges största och snabbast växande marknadsplats för begagnade bilar. Idag består bolaget av ca 600 medarbetare i Sverige. Här är gemenskap, en familjär atmosfär och möjligheten till personlig utveckling viktiga delar - trots bolagets storlek. Nu utökar vi vårt säljteam ytterligare och söker därför drivna lagspelare till vår nyöppnade och största butik i Linköping.

Om dig
Vi söker personer med specifika attityder och egenskaper, samt med en tidigare framgångsrik bakgrund inom försäljning. Gillar du förändring och triggas av utmaningar? Är du ständigt nyfiken och beredd att göra det lilla extra? Älskar du kundkontakt och brinner för den magi som uppstår vid en god försäljning? Då kan du vara rätt medarbetare för oss – och vi arbetsplatsen för dig. Vi gillar mångfald och ser gärna att fler tjejer söker våra tjänster.

Att sälja hos oss
Är enkelt. Har du ett högt engagemang, lyhördhet, ett starkt intresse och mod? Då lär vi dig att sälja. Bilförsäljning hos oss är modernt och kundfokuserat och affärerna görs lika enkelt och snabbt som noggrant och personligt. I rollen som bilförsäljare på Riddermark Bil arbetar du med bilaffärens alla steg, från första kundkontakt och provkörning till leverans och eftervård. Riddermark Bil har Sveriges största utbud av begagnade bilar. Därför blir förmågan att kunna göra en relevant behovsanalys och snabbt skapa en relation med kunden avgörande. Som säljare hos oss jobbar du i team om 5–8 personer med en gruppchef som har till uppgift att leda gruppen mot tydliga gemensamma mål.


Urval sker löpande och vi behöver din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi är idag ca 600 anställda fördelade på 14 butiker, ett logistikcenter och ett huvudkontor. Trots vår storlek beskrivs vi ofta som ett mindre familjebolag, här får du vara med och påverka och hjälpa till att hela tiden driva vår tillväxt i rätt riktning med fler och nöjdare kunder. Riddermark bil är ett utav Sveriges mest expansiva företag, den självklara marknadsplatsen för begagnade bilar. Stolt leder vi utvecklingen inom försäljning och avyttring av begagnade bilar genom lagarbete, nytänkande och lyhördhet. Med flera stora anläggningar i Sverige hjälper vi privatpersoner och företag med sina bilaffärer. Vi bygger och utvecklar egna IT-system om vi helt enkelt anser att det saknas tillräckligt bra sådana, och varje dag strävar vi efter att göra allting lite bättre. Våra medarbetare rekryteras främst för sina värderingar.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

 

OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityis Norway's third-largest university, with 23,000 students and more than 2,600 employees. We have campuses in central Oslo and the Romerike region. Our research and education address the needs of working life, the welfare state, and the wider metropolitan region.

 

For more than 200 years,OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityhas contributed to building the knowledge and expertise that underpin the Norwegian welfare state. Today, OsloMet is a modern, urban university with strong academic environments in teacher education, health and social sciences, social research, design, and technology.

jobs.title: Thon Hotel Oslo Airport søker A la Carte Hovmester

Vi driver nå med å utvide med flere hotellrom, og skal også utvide restauranten, som vil gi flere og spennende karrieremuligheter.

jobs.title: Material modelling engineer
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic Turbine Mechanical Integrity team as a Material Model Engineer! Imagine being at the forefront of innovation, where you will engage in the entire process—from test planning to the development and implementation of material models that are essential for our engineering team. You will collaborate closely with our colleagues in the materials laboratory, ensuring that your contributions directly impact our projects. Our team tackles a variety of tasks, including finite element (FE) analysis, alloy development, constitutive modeling, and methodology development, while also providing vital support to workshops, procurement, and service.



How You’ll Make an Impact



    Develop, implement, and enhance constitutive and life material models for high-temperature applications.
    Contribute to the development of methodologies and procedures for constitutive and life material modeling.
    Support development and technology projects by assessing, planning, and evaluating material testing.
    Provide assistance in response to inquiries from manufacturing and customers.



What You Bring



    A Ph.D. in Solid Mechanics or a related field.
    Extensive expertise in material modeling, backed by several years of experience and a solid theoretical foundation.
    Experience with FE analysis for lifing calculations, along with a strong understanding of relevant principles and methodologies.
    Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
    A collaborative mindset paired with strong communication skills.



About the Team
You will be part of an experienced team with diverse backgrounds and responsibilities. We strive to support one another and build a strong technical knowledge base within the team. Our commitment to developing long-term competencies makes us an ideal environment for individuals eager to grow and advance their careers alongside us.



Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.



We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.



Who is Siemens Energy?



At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.



Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.



Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo



Our Commitment to Diversity



Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.



Application

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.



We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.title: Underhållsplanerare till Orkla Foods Sverige i Kungshamn
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Orkla Foods Sverige tillagar mat och dryck i Sverige med kärlek och omtanke om människor, hav och land. Vi är en lokal samhällsaktör som med över 1400 medarbetare gör skillnad och bidrar till en mer hållbar och hälsosam vardag. Ca 90 procent av den mat och dryck vi säljer i Sverige tillagar vi lokalt på någon av våra 8 anläggningar runt om i landet. Vi går i täten för hållbar produktutveckling och innovation genom våra välkända varumärken som Felix, Grandiosa, Abba, Kalles, BOB, Ekströms, Risifrutti, Önos, FUN Light, Anamma, Krögarklass, och Paulúns. Vi har en omsättning på cirka 6 miljarder kronor och vårt huvudkontor i Malmö. Vår vision är att vi vill skapa ”En god framtid” genom att leva upp till våra värdeord – modig, pålitlig och inspirerande.

Om rollen

Vill du vara med och skapa driftsäkerhet i hjärtat av svensk matproduktion?

Om rollen

Vi söker nu en underhållsplanerare till vår verksamhet i Kungshamn – en viktig roll för dig som vill kombinera tekniskt intresse, struktur och problemlösning i en produktionsmiljö där kvalitet, säkerhet och ständiga förbättringar står i centrum. Här får du planera och koordinera underhållsinsatser som bidrar till ökad driftsäkerhet, effektivare arbetssätt och en stabil produktion av några av Sveriges mest välkända varumärken.

Som underhållsplanerare ansvarar du för att planera, resurssätta och schemalägga fabrikens förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll. Du får en central roll i att skapa struktur, framförhållning och rätt förutsättningar för att underhållsarbetet ska kunna genomföras säkert, effektivt och med minsta möjliga påverkan på produktionen. Rollen är placerad i Kungshamn och du arbetar nära underhållschef, produktion, tekniker, inköps- och förrådsansvarig samt externa leverantörer.

I rollen blir du en viktig person i arbetet med att utveckla fabrikens underhållsprocesser. Du säkerställer att rätt resurser, reservdelar, material och underlag finns på plats inför planerade insatser, samtidigt som du bidrar till att identifiera förbättringar, driva tekniska initiativ och utveckla mer långsiktiga arbetssätt tillsammans med teamet.

Vad du får möjlighet att arbeta med

    Planera fabrikens underhåll utifrån optimala underhållsfönster, produktionens behov och tillgängliga resurser.
    Koordinera underhållsarbeten med interna tekniker, produktion, inköp och externa leverantörer.
    Säkerställa att rätt komponenter, reservdelar, material och dokumentation finns tillgängliga inför planerade insatser.
    Ta in offerter, sammanställa beslutsunderlag och bidra vid planering av större underhållsarbeten och tekniska förbättringar.
    Följa upp genomförda arbeten, analysera avvikelser och bidra till förbättrad driftsäkerhet, effektivitet och kvalitet.
    Utveckla underhållsstrategin och den långsiktiga underhållsplanen tillsammans med underhållschef.
    Arbeta aktivt med ständiga förbättringar, standardiserade arbetssätt och tydligare struktur i underhållsprocessen.

Kravspecifikation



Vi söker dig som

För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en strukturerad, noggrann och lösningsorienterad person som tycker om att skapa ordning, driva saker framåt och få människor och processer att samverka. Du har lätt för att prioritera, kommunicera tydligt och anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras i en händelserik produktionsmiljö.

Du har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och trivs i en roll där planering, samarbete och praktisk problemlösning går hand i hand. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från industriell verksamhet och förståelse för hur ett välfungerande underhåll bidrar till säkerhet, kvalitet, leveransförmåga och effektiv produktion.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

    Teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig.
    Erfarenhet från industriell verksamhet, gärna inom underhåll, produktion eller teknisk planering.
    God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta strukturerat i digitala system.
    Förmåga att skapa överblick, prioritera och koordinera flera aktiviteter samtidigt.
    God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner.
    Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av SAP eller annat underhålls-/affärssystem.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet och söker dig som delar våra värderingar: du är modig, pålitlig och inspirerande. Hos oss betyder det att du vågar ta initiativ, håller det du lovar och bidrar till ett öppet och engagerat samarbete i vardagen.

Ytterligare information



Varför du kommer trivas här

Orkla Foods Sverige är ett av Sveriges största livsmedelsföretag, med lokal produktion på sju orter i Sverige och flera av landets mest älskade varumärken. Våra cirka 25 varumärken och över 500 produkter är en del av människors vardag i miljontals hem, varje dag. Hos oss får du vara med och bidra till produkter som många har en stark relation till – samtidigt som vi utvecklar framtidens matproduktion med omtanke om människor, hav och land.

Att arbeta i Kungshamn är att kliva in i en av Sveriges mest unika produktionsmiljöer, nära havet och med en lång tradition av hantverk, kvalitet och stolthet. Här tillverkas produkter inom sjömat och kaviar med stark lokal förankring och hög igenkänning, bland annat inom varumärken som Abba och Kalles. Som underhållsplanerare får du en viktig roll i att skapa stabilitet och utveckling i en verksamhet där teknik, tradition och framtid möts.



Din ansökan

Låter det här som nästa steg i din karriär? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Ansök gärna så snart som möjligt eller tipsa någon i ditt nätverk som du tror skulle passa för rollen.

Du läser hela annonsen och söker tjänsten smidigast via vår karriärsida på Orkla Foods Sverige. För att säkerställa en rättvis och GDPR-säker rekryteringsprocess har vi tyvärr inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via e-post.

På grund stort intresse har vi ibland begränsad möjlighet att svara på frågor såvida du inte har specifika frågor som är viktiga för att kunna ta ställning till en ansökan, då är du varmt välkommen att kontakta HR Nadine Tehyrell på nadine.tehyrell@orklafoods.se.

Vi hoppas få möjlighet att lära känna dig och berätta mer om hur det är att vara en del av Orkla Foods Sverige.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Som en del av Orkla ingår vi i ett internationellt varumärkesbolag med starka positioner i Norden och flera marknader världen över. Det ger oss möjligheten att kombinera styrkan i ett större sammanhang med det lokala engagemanget nära marknaden och människorna som möter våra produkter varje dag.

jobs.title: Accounting Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Accounting Business Analyst for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.



Accounting Business Analyst

We are seeking a highly experienced accounting specialists for a consulting assignment within a large-scale financial transformation initiative.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in accounting and reconciliation of financial records in a complex enterprise environment. You are expected to independently analyse, design and document financial business processes from multiple front-end systems, detail resulting accounting patterns, in a complex enterprise environment.

﻿

ART Initiative

The company is running an initiative called ART, Accounting and Reporting Transformation, with the objective of moving accounting functionality from several legacy accounting solutions to a new cloud-based solution.

Integration with other systems is ongoing, including business applications delivering accounting data, source systems, and downstream consumers of accounting and reporting information.

﻿

The initiative includes several agile teams working across IT development, integration, infrastructure, security, and business processes. The solution includes development of customized bank-specific functionality running on dedicated server instances in the Oracle sovereign cloud, updates to legacy systems, and configuration and integration of an accounting SaaS solution provided by Oracle.

﻿

Required Skills & Experience

Strong ability to analyse accounting, reconciliation and reporting requirements and translate them into process descriptions, accounting patterns and system requirements

Hands-on and broad accounting experience and confident in describing accounting scenarios, for example using T-accounts

Strong ability to train and coach end-users to confidently and efficiently use the resulting accounting solutions

Experience in planning, preparing and executing tests of financial processes and accounting solutions in a large, multinational enterprise

Experience with financial services, accounting, regulatory reporting, and other highly regulated business domains

Experience working in agile development teams and collaborating across application, integration, test, and business functions

Strong written and spoken English communication skills

﻿

Education

Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

Equivalent professional experience may be considered

﻿

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in integrating large scale and custom business applications using Oracle Financials Cloud or similar, comprehensive accounting system

Experience in Change Management, organizational transformation, and user training

﻿

Key Responsibilities

Analyse functional and non-functional requirements and translate those into accounting and configuration specifications

Translate business, accounting, reporting and reconciliation requirements into implementable system requirements

Support configuration, operation, and maintenance of an accounting solution based on Oracle Financials Cloud and other supporting financial solutions

Collaborate with business stakeholders, system architects, and development teams to clarify functional and non-functional requirements

Produce and maintain high-level and low-level design documentation and test-scripts

Support testing, deployment, release, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and remediation in non-production and production environments

Contribute to common accounting standards, reconciliation principles, and ways of working

Participate actively in agile ceremonies and cross-team planning

Share knowledge and provide solution guidance to other project team members when required

Training and coaching end-users in using the configured solution

﻿

Personal Attributes

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

High attention to quality, details and consistency

Ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership of deliverables

Mind-set to drive continuous improvements within areas of responsibility but also within the team

Structured and methodical approach to complex assignments

jobs.title: Lead Project Leader - AWS AI
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 6456

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.



Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

jobs.title: International Trainee - Business Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.



About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

  

Your role as a Trainee – Business Engineer

As a Trainee Business Engineer you will join Customer Relations and Connections B2B within Vattenfall Eldistribution, where we partner with some of Sweden’s largest energy producers and large consumers. Here, you will have the chance to contribute to the energy transition and gain hands-on experience in supporting the large-scale electrification of society.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience working with customer connection projects, strategic customer relationships, and sustainable energy solutions. You will collaborate with customers, technical specialists, project managers and colleagues across the business, gradually taking on increasing responsibility for your own customer portfolio. This is an opportunity to develop expertise in key account management, customer engagement and electricity distribution while contributing to the energy transition and supporting solutions that create value for customers, Vattenfall, and society.



Your responsibilities:  

    Support customer connection projects from initial dialogue through planning and implementation.
    Build and maintain strong relationships with industrial customers and key stakeholders.
    Contribute to commercial discussions, customer agreements, and business development activities.
    Analyze customer needs and identify opportunities that support electrification and sustainable growth.
    Prepare business cases, cost estimates, and customer presentations.
    Support the development of innovative ways of working through digitalization and automation.
    Support the business in leveraging data, analytics, and reporting to improve decision-making across Vattenfall Eldistribution.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Business Engineer

    University degree in Industrial Engineering and Management, Engineering, Business or a related field.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
    An interest in technical systems and to work with cost estimates and financial calculations.

We are looking for someone who is curious, driven, and eager to learn. You enjoy taking initiative, challenging existing ways of working, and contributing with new perspectives. As a person, you combine analytical thinking with strong interpersonal skills and thrive in environments where collaboration and continuous improvement are key.

You enjoy building relationships and communicating with different stakeholders, creating trust through a service-minded and professional approach. You are interested in business, enjoy presenting ideas, and can navigate constructive discussions with both customers and colleagues. An interest in innovation, digitalization, AI, and continuous improvement is highly valued, as we are constantly looking for new ways to improve processes and create better solutions.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  



To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.



Location:

You will be working in the department Customer Relations and Connections B2B and located in Solna (Sweden).

jobs.title: Sosial og kreativ 22-åring søker nye BPA assistenter på Mortensrud !🌸
jobs.description:

Hei!

Jeg er en sosial og kreativ jente på 22 år som bor i Søndre Nordstrand i Oslo (Mortensrud/ Dal) sammen med mine foreldre og to søsken. På fritiden liker jeg å dra på kjøpesenter, spise ute, gå på kino og være sammen med familie og venner. Jeg er også glad i å tegne, male og spille spill. Nå ser jeg etter en eller flere assistenter som kan bidra til at jeg får en aktiv, morsom og selvstendig hverdag.

Da jeg var barn, ble jeg utsatt for en bilulykke som har gitt meg lettere fysiske utfordringer og en lett utviklingshemming. Jeg kommuniserer godt og deltar aktivt i hverdagen min, men trenger praktisk bistand og støtte til ulike gjøremål og aktiviteter.

Stilling og arbeidstid

Jeg søker nå en fast assistent i en stilling på 12t i uken. Arbeidstiden er hovedsakelig på hverdager fra ca. kl. 14.00-20.00, med noe arbeid i helger mellom kl. 10.00-20.00. Arbeidstider kan varier noe i ferier- dette finner vi ut av sammen.

Oppgi gjerne i din søknad om det er noen dager/ tider du ikke har anledning til å jobbe.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Ta imot meg når jeg kommer hjem fra jobb/dagsenter

  • Lage og tilrettelegge måltider sammen med meg

  • Bistå ved skift og personlig hygiene, inkludert dusj (ingen tunge løft)

  • Bli med på gåturer i nærområdet

  • Følge til fysioterapeut

  • Vaske og stryke klær

  • Holde rommet mitt ryddig

  • Stelle planter

  • Delta på sosiale aktiviteter, familiebesøk og andre hyggelige sammenkomster

Hvem ser jeg etter?

  • Du er positiv, omsorgsfull og tålmodig

  • Du er initiativrik og liker å motivere og utfordre meg på en god måte

  • Du er trygg i voksenrollen, samtidig som du gjerne er i nærheten av min egen alder

  • Du trives med å være sosial og bygge gode relasjoner

  • Du er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Det er et pluss om du snakker urdu, slik at du kan kommunisere med min mor

  • Kan gjøre deg godt forstått og forstå norsk godt (B1 Norsk kurs)

  • Førerkort er ønskelig, men ikke et krav

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

  • Grunnet stillings natur, oppfordres kvinner til å søke

Hos meg får du en variert og meningsfull jobb hvor du blir en viktig del av hverdagen min. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i beskrivelsen og ønsker en jobb der ingen dager er helt like, håper jeg å høre fra deg! 😊

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hanna Brurås på epost: hanna.bruras@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

jobs.title: Sjåfør - Distribusjon - førerkort klasse B
jobs.description:
Sjåfør søkes til Leko Matter AS

Leko Matter AS søker flere pålitelige og serviceinnstilte sjåfører til distribusjon av matter og mopper i Oslo og omegn.

Arbeidet består hovedsakelig av levering og henting av matter og mopper hos våre bedriftskunder. Du vil ha en selvstendig arbeidshverdag med faste ruter og kundekontakt.

Det er en fordel om du er kjent i Oslo og omegn, gjerne gjennom tidligere arbeid med distribusjon, transport eller levering. Tidligere erfaring som sjåfør er imidlertid ikke et krav, da full opplæring vil bli gitt.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har førerkort klasse B

  • Behersker norsk eller engelsk

  • Er pålitelig, stabil og ansvarsbevisst

  • Trives med en selvstendig og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Er serviceinnstilt og komfortabel med kundekontakt

  • Gjerne er kjent i Oslo og omegn

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn

  • Ordnede arbeidsforhold

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Fem ukers ferie

  • Full opplæring

  • En selvstendig arbeidshverdag i et etablert norsk selskap

Pålitelighet og stabilitet er viktig for oss, og vi ønsker at dette så langt som mulig kan dokumenteres gjennom attester og referanser fra tidligere arbeidsforhold.

Søknad:

Send en kortfattet søknad på norsk eller engelsk, gjerne med CV og en beskrivelse av relevant arbeidserfaring.

Telefonhenvendelser og personlig oppmøte i forbindelse med stillingen ønskes ikke.

Mer informasjon om Leko Matter AS finner du på www.leko.no.

English summary

Leko Matter AS is looking for reliable and service-minded drivers for the delivery and collection of mats and mops in Oslo and the surrounding areas.

A category B driving licence is required. Previous professional driving experience is not necessary, as full training will be provided. Knowledge of Oslo and the surrounding areas is an advantage.

You must be able to communicate in either Norwegian or English. We are looking for reliable, responsible and stable employees who enjoy working independently and providing good customer service.

We offer competitive pay, flexible working hours, five weeks of holiday and good working conditions.

Please submit your application and CV in Norwegian or English. No phone enquiries or personal visits, please.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Leko Matter AS er en veletablert norsk bedrift med lang erfaring innen utleie, vask og distribusjon av matter og mopper til bedriftsmarkedet. Vi holder til på Langhus og betjener kunder i sentrale østlandsområdet. Vi legger vekt på høy servicegrad, kvalitet, pålitelighet og gode langsiktige kunderelasjoner. Leko Matter AS er Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisert. Se mer info om oss på våre nettsider.

jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy (WLSA) is responsible for delivering high-quality learning services to customers and employees around the world. Our training portfolio supports Wärtsilä's innovative technologies and solutions across the marine and energy sectors, helping customers develop the skills needed for a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an enthusiastic Training Coordinator to join our Training Coordination team in Vaasa, Finland. Whilst we offer hybrid working, the operational nature of our business often requires attendance on site, and occasional flexibility outside normal working hours may be required.

In this role, you will be at the heart of our global training operations, working closely with customers, instructors, sales teams, and business stakeholders to ensure an outstanding learning experience from initial enquiry to training completion. You will combine customer service, operational coordination, digital tools, and continuous improvement to deliver successful training programmes that create value for our customers and Wärtsilä.


If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships, and coordinating multiple activities simultaneously, this could be your next career opportunity.



What will you be doing?


As a Training Coordinator, you will manage and coordinate the end-to-end training delivery process while ensuring a seamless customer experience.


Your responsibilities will include:


Training Operations



* Coordinate training delivery activities at the Vaasa Training Centre and other assigned learning environments.
* Manage course scheduling, participant registrations, notifications, reporting, and training documentation.
* Maintain training records and related data in SAP, Learning Management Systems, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate resources (instructors, classrooms, workshop) allocation.
* Support training delivery and help resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve services and processes.



Customer and Business Support


* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of training activities for internal and external customers.
* Create and maintain training offerings and service packages.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, contract management, and business stakeholders to promote learning solutions.
* Support internal and external communication activities related to training services.


What will help you succeed?



We are looking for someone who combines strong coordination skills with a passion for customer service and continuous improvement.


You will ideally have:



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience with Learning management systems (LMS), training administration, learning operations, customer service, project coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working with SAP and Salesforce would be considered an advantage.
* Strong digital skills and confidence in learning new systems and technologies.
* Excellent, organisational and multitasking abilities. You will be adept at coordinating evolving requirements and will frequently need to adapt to factors outside your control.
* A structured and detail-oriented way of working.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive mindset and ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise tasks effectively. You will be empowered to make decisions within your scope to advance your workload.
* A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality service.
* Fluent English skills, both written and spoken.
* Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.


Why join us?


At Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy, you will become part of a global learning organisation that plays a key role in developing the competencies needed for the future of energy and marine industries. We believe that great results come from empowered people. We encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration, creating an environment where individuals can contribute, develop, and make a meaningful difference.


As part of our global learning organisation, you will work alongside experienced professionals in a culture built on respect, inclusion, and continuous learning. We value openness, encourage new ideas, and see challenges as opportunities to improve. Everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic self to work and contribute their unique perspective.


We particularly appreciate candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to professional growth. Experience gained across different functions, projects, or disciplines is highly valued, as it helps us build agile teams capable of supporting a diverse and evolving business environment.

jobs.description:
På vegne af en integreret børneinstitution i Gørløse, Hillerød Kommune, søger FIRMAVIKAR en stabil og erfaren køkkenvikar til et længerevarende vikariat med opstart mandag den 21. september.

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift af køkkenet og for at tilberede mad til ca. 43 børn. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt, kan skabe struktur i hverdagen og tager ansvar for, at køkkenet fungerer godt fra dag til dag.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Selvstændig drift af køkkenet

  • Tilberedning og klargøring af mad til ca. 43 børn

  • Smørrebrød og kolde retter ca. 3 dage om ugen

  • Lettere varme retter ca. 2 dage om ugen

  • Klargøring af råvarer og grøntsager

  • Anretning og klargøring af maden

  • Opvask, oprydning og rengøring i køkkenet

  • Øvrige almindelige køkkenopgaver efter behov

Vi søger dig, som

  • Har relevant erfaring fra køkken, kantine, institution eller lignende

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for den daglige drift

  • Er stabil, møder til tiden og arbejder struktureret

  • Har en god forståelse for hygiejne og orden i et køkken

  • Trives med at lave mad til børn

  • Er fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst i dit arbejde

Praktiske oplysninger

Periode:
Mandag den 21. september til fredag den 27. november

Arbejdstid:
Mandag til fredag kl. 07.30–13.30

Ugentligt timetal:
Ca. 30 timer

Arbejdssted:
Integreret børneinstitution i Gørløse, Hillerød Kommune

Har stillingen din interesse, hører vi meget gerne fra dig hurtigst muligt.

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee – Analyst Group Strategy

You will join Group Strategy, where we shape Vattenfall's strategic direction and long-term development. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and gain unique insight into how strategic decisions are developed and implemented across the company. You will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and contribute to initiatives that support Vattenfall's future development. As your knowledge and experience grow, you will gradually take on greater responsibility. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in strategy while bringing fresh perspectives and ideas to the team.

Your responsibilities:

    Supporting strategic analyses, portfolio-level discussions and company-wide strategic initiatives
    Helping structure complex questions and translate them into clear insights and recommendations
    Preparing strategic presentations, briefings, and communication material for senior stakeholders
    Supporting workshops, meetings, and stakeholder dialogues across the organization

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Analyst Group Strategy

    Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Economics, or a related field with a strong business focus
    Previous internship experience within strategy, consulting, finance or a related area

You should also recognize yourself in

    Strong analytical skills, able to work with both details and the bigger picture
    Excellent communication skills, both verbally and in writing
    Strong stakeholder management skills
    Self-leadership and the ability to work independently
    Communication skills in Swedish or another Nordic language

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Group Strategy and located in Stockholm (Solna), Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations. Each position comes with a competitive salary and excellent remuneration package. Read more about the elements of the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme here.

Application process

We welcome your application in English via the application button on this page. Please include an updated resume. When applying, you will fill out screening questions, including your motivation. No cover letter or motivation letter is needed. The deadline to apply is October 18th, 2026. Selection will start after the application period with online tests, followed by interviews between the end of October to end November.

ΓΥΑΛΙΣΜΑ (ΑΛΟΙΦΕΣ) ΚΑΙ ΔΙΟΡΘΩΣΗ ΜΙΚΡΩΝ ΑΤΕΛΕΙΩΝ Η "ΝΕΦΩΝ" ΜΕΤΑ ΤΟ ΒΑΨΙΜΟ.  ΚΑΘΑΡΙΣΜΟΣ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ (ΠΙΣΤΟΛΙΑ ΒΑΦΗΣ) ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΤΟΥ ΧΩΡΟΥ ΤΟΥ ΒΑΦΕΙΟΥ , ΝΑ ΜΙΛΑΕΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΑ , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.description: ΑΞΙΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΚΤΑΣΗΣ ΤΗΣ ΠΑΡΑΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ ΣΤΟ ΣΑΣΙ ΚΑΙ ΤΙΣ ΛΑΜΑΡΙΝΕΣ. ΙΣΙΩΜΑ, ΕΠΑΝΑΦΟΡΑ ΚΑΙ ΣΦΥΡΗΛΑΤΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΜΕΡΩΝ. ΑΦΑΙΡΕΣΗ ΕΞΑΡΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ (Π.Χ. ΠΡΟΦΥΛΑΚΤΗΡΕΣ, ΠΟΡΤΕΣ) ΓΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΒΑΣΗ ΣΤΑ ΣΗΜΕΙΑ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΗΣ ΧΡΗΣΗ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ ΟΞΥΓΟΝΟΚΟΛΛΗΣΗΣ Η ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΣΥΓΚΟΛΛΗΣΗΣ ΓΙΑ ΑΝΤΙΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ Η ΕΠΙΔΙΟΡΘΩΣΗ ΚΑΤΕΣΤΡΑΜΜΕΝΩΝ ΤΜΗΜΑΤΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΠΙΦΑΝΕΙΑΣ (ΣΤΟΚΑΡΙΣΜΑ, ΤΡΙΨΙΜΟ) ΠΡΙΝ ΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ ΠΕΡΑΣΕΙ ΣΤΟ ΤΜΗΜΑ ΒΑΦΗΣ  , ΝΑ ΜΙΛΑΕΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΑ , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.description: -ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΗ, ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΟΙΚΙΑΚΩΝ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΣΚΕΥΩΝ (ΠΛΗΝΤΗΡΙΑ, ΦΟΥΡΝΟΙ, ΨΥΓΕΙΑ Κ.Α.). - ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΡΥΘΜΙΣΗ ΚΛΙΜΑΤΙΣΤΙΚΩΝ ΜΟΝΑΔΩΝ (A/C), ΤΗΛΕΟΡΑΣΕΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΛΟΙΠΩΝ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΣΚΕΥΩΝ. - ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΤΟΥΣ ΜΕ ΕΠΑΓΓΕΛΜΑΤΙΣΜΟ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙ , ΠΡΟΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΣΕ ΑΝΤΙΣΤΟΙΧΗ ΘΕΣΗ (ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ / ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΕΙΣ). ΤΕΧΝΙΚΕΣ ΓΝΩΣΕΙΣ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΛΟΓΙΑΣ, ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΗΣ Η ΨΥΚΤΙΚΩΝ ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΕΩΝ (ΘΑ ΕΚΤΙΜΗΘΕΙ ΙΔΙΑΙΤΕΡΑ).  ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ. ΕΚΠΛΗΡΩΜΕΝΕΣ ΣΤΡΑΤΙΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΥΠΟΧΡΕΩΣΕΙΣ. , Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΒΟΗΘΗΤΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΣΕ ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΕΙΣ ΦΩΤΟΒΟΛΤΑΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΣΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ. ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ, ΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΒΑΣΕΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΠΑΝΕΛΩΝ, ΟΔΕΥΣΗ ΚΑΛΩΔΙΩΝ, ΥΠΟ ΤΗΝ ΚΑΘΟΔΗΓΗΣΗ ΑΔΕΙΟΥΧΟΥ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΛΟΓΟΥ. ΠΕΝΘΗΜΕΡΗ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ 40 ΩΡΕΣ (ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ 07:00-15:00). , ΔΕΝ ΑΠΑΙΤΕΙΤΑΙ ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΠΕΙΡΑ. ΕΡΓΑΤΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΕΞΩΤΕΡΙΚΟΥΣ ΧΩΡΟΥΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΕ ΥΨΟΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.description: ΤΟΝ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟ, ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΦΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΣΥΣΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗΣ ISO,ΤΗΝ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΠΙΣΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗΣ, ΤΗ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ ΜΕ ΤΑ ΑΠΑΙΤΟΥΜΕΝΑ ΠΡΟΤΥΠΑ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΝΟΝΙΣΜΟΥΣ, ΤΗΝ ΠΡΑΓΜΑΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΕΠΙΤΟΠΙΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΨΕΩΝ ΣΕ ΓΕΩΡΓΟΚΤΗΝΟΤΡΟΦΟΥΣ ,ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΣΥΜΒΟΥΛΕΥΤΙΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ ΓΙΑ ΘΕΜΑΤΑ ΠΟΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ, ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ, ΤΗ ΣΥΝΤΑΞΗ ΕΚΘΕΣΕΩΝ, ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΧΕΤΙΚΗΣ ΤΕΚΜΗΡΙΩΣΗΣ , ΠΤΥΧΙΟ ΓΕΩΠΟΝΟΥ , ΤΕΧΝΟΛΟΓΟΥ ΓΕΩΠΟΝΟΥ, ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΜΕ ΧΡΟΝΙΚΑ ΠΕΡΙΘΩΡΙΑ, ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ, ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ MS OFFICE, ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , MARIA IOAKIM , mioakim@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΠΩΛΗΤΗ/ΤΡΙΑ (RETAIL) ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΑΡΧΙΑ ΑΜΜΟΧΩΣΤΟΥ.
jobs.description: ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΤΟΥ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟΥ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΕΥΡΕΣΗ ΝΕΩΝ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ.  ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΟΥ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΨΕΩΝ ΣΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΑΠΟΘΕΜΑΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΣΗΜΕΙΑ ΠΩΛΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΙΣ ΑΠΟΘΗΚΕΣ ΤΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ.  ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗ ΟΡΘΗΣ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΒΟΛΗΣ ΤΩΝ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΑ.  ΣΥΝΤΟΝΙΣΜΟΣ,ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΥΛΟΠΟΙΗΣΗΣ ΠΡΟΩΘΗΤΙΚΩΝ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ.  ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΝΗΜΕΡΩΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΚΑΙΝΟΥΡΙΑ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΑ, ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΕΜΠΟΡΙΚΕΣ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΕΣ.  ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΤΡΟΦΗΣ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ (ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ, ΚΑΤΑΧΩΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗΣ) ΚΑΤΑΧΩΡΗΣΗ ΠΑΡΑΓΓΕΛΙΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΟΥ ΕΤΑΙΡΙΚΟΥ ΣΥΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΕΙΣΠΡΑΞΕΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΠΙΣΤΩΤΙΚΗ ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑΣ  , ΚΑΤΟΧΟΣ ΑΔΕΙΑΣ ΟΔΗΓΗΣΗΣ(MANUAL). ΑΡΙΣΤΕΣ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ & ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ. ΑΝΑΛΗΨΗΣ ΠΡΩΤΟΒΟΥΛΙΩΝ & ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΕΥΘΥΝΩΝ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΩΝ ΥΠΟΛΟΓΙΣΤΩΝ.  ΠΡΟΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΣΕ ΠΑΡΟΜΟΙΑ ΘΕΣΗ, ΙΔΑΝΙΚΑ ΣΤΟΝ ΚΛΑΔΟ ΤΡΟΦΙΜΩΝ, ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , SOPHIA PAPETTA , spapetta@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΣΕΡΒΙΤΟΡΟΙ Γ΄
jobs.description: ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΑΙΘΟΥΣΑΣ ΕΣΤΙΑΣΗΣ ΠΡΙΝ ΑΠΟ ΤΗΝ ΕΝΑΡΞΗ ΤΗΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑΣ. ΣΤΡΩΣΙΜΟ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΣΜΟΣ ΤΡΑΠΕΖΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΑ ΠΡΟΤΥΠΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΠΙΧΕΙΡΗΣΗΣ. ΥΠΟΔΟΧΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΘΟΔΗΓΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΣΤΙΣ ΘΕΣΕΙΣ ΤΟΥΣ. ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΝΕΡΟΥ, ΨΩΜΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΒΑΣΙΚΗΣ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΣΤΟΥΣ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ. ΛΗΨΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΠΑΡΑΓΓΕΛΙΩΝ ΠΡΟΣ ΤΗΝ ΚΟΥΖΙΝΑ Η/ΚΑΙ ΤΟ ΜΠΑΡ, ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ. ΣΕΡΒΙΡΙΣΜΑ ΦΑΓΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΠΟΤΩΝ ΜΕ ΕΠΑΓΓΕΛΜΑΤΙΣΜΟ ΚΑΙ ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ. ΣΥΛΛΟΓΗ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΗΜΕΝΩΝ ΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΤΩΝ ΤΡΑΠΕΖΙΩΝ ΚΑΘ' ΟΛΗ ΤΗ ΔΙΑΡΚΕΙΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗΣ. ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΜΕ ΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟ ΤΗΣ ΚΟΥΖΙΝΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥ ΜΠΑΡ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΟΜΑΛΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΓΚΑΙΡΗ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΟΛΩΝ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΙΕΙΝΗΣ , ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ Η/ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ. ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΓΡΗΓΟΡΟ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΑΙΤΗΤΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ. ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΠΟΛΥΩΡΗΣ ΟΡΘΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΕΡΓΑΤΗΣ
jobs.description: ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ, ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ-ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑ ΤΩΝ ΧΩΡΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ, ΝΑ ΒΟΗΘΑ ΑΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΓΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΞΥΛΟΥΡΓΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΠΛΩΝ , ΕΡΓΑΤΙΚΟΣ, ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΜΟΣ, ΤΥΠΙΚΟΣ ΣΤΗΝ ΩΡΑ ΤΟΥ, ΠΡΟΘΥΜΟΣ ΝΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΕΙ ΥΠΟ ΣΥΝΘΗΚΕΣ ΠΙΕΣΗΣ , EURES ADVISOR , MARIA IOAKIM , mioakim@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.title: ΜΑΓΕΙΡΑΣ Γ'

jobs.title: Vernepleier/sosionom til tverrfaglig ruspoliklinikk - lengre vikariat
jobs.description:
Eikaklinikken søker en vernepleier eller sosionom til et lengre vikariat med snarlig tiltredelse.

Vikariatet er knyttet til fravær i personalgruppen. Vi har kjent behov for vikar fra våren 2027, og det er derfor gode muligheter for et sammenhengende vikariat over en lengre periode.

Hva vi ser etter

Stillingen innebærer selvstendig oppfølging av pasienter fra oppstart, og vi søker derfor en kandidat som allerede har solid erfaring fra målgruppen og god kjennskap til tjenesteapparatet i Oslo.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • autorisasjon som vernepleier eller bachelor i sosialt arbeid

  • minimum tre års relevant erfaring fra arbeid med målgruppen

  • god kjennskap til Oslo kommunes organisering, bydelstjenester og aktuelle tilbud innen rus, psykisk helse og sosiale tjenester

  • erfaring fra tverrfaglig og tverretatlig samarbeid med kommunale tjenester i Oslo

  • erfaring fra samarbeid med spesialisthelsetjenesten

Vi legger særlig vekt på at du:

  • arbeider selvstendig og strukturert

  • gode evner til å finne løsninger

  • har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter

  • klarer å kombinere fleksibilitet med tydelige profesjonelle rammer

  • har god rolleforståelse og faglig dømmekraft

  • samarbeider godt med pasienter, kolleger og eksterne tjenester

  • trives i en liten virksomhet hvor ansatte må ta ansvar og bidra på tvers

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som vernepleier/sosionom vil du inngå i klinikkens tverrfaglige team og ha ansvar for oppfølging av egne pasienter. Oppfølgingen kan blant annet bestå av samtaler på klinikken, telefonkontakt, hjemmebesøk, aktivitet, følge til avtaler og samarbeid med andre tjenester. Kontaktperson har en sentral rolle i å koordinere oppfølgingen og bidra til tydelig ansvars- og rollefordeling rundt pasienten.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • individuell oppfølging og kontaktpersonansvar

  • kartlegging av pasientens behov og ressurser

  • samarbeid med leger og øvrige ansatte ved klinikken

  • samarbeid med kommunale tjenester, NAV og spesialisthelsetjenesten

  • deltakelse i ansvarsgrupper og tverrfaglige møter

  • dokumentasjon og annet faglig arbeid knyttet til pasientoppfølging

  • bidra til fagutvikling og kvalitetsarbeid ved klinikken

Vi tilbyr

  • en faglig variert arbeidshverdag med stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar

  • arbeid i et lite, tverrfaglig miljø med korte beslutningsveier

  • mulighet til å arbeide tett og langsiktig med en kompleks pasientgruppe, med stort faglig handlingsrom og tett samarbeid mellom lege-, helse- og sosialfaglig kompetanse

  • ordinær arbeidstid på dagtid

  • lønn etter avtale

  • pensjonsordning i DNB med 4 % innskudd

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Eikaklinikken er en tverrfaglig klinikk for mennesker med rusmiddelproblemer og sammensatte helse- og livsutfordringer. Mange av våre pasienter har behov for langvarig, fleksibel og koordinert oppfølging, ofte i samarbeid med flere deler av hjelpeapparatet. Vi arbeider helhetlig og individuelt, med utgangspunkt i den enkeltes behov, mål og livssituasjon. Oppfølgingen skjer i tverrfaglige team bestående av leger, sykepleiere, sosialfaglig personell og miljøpersonale, og kan omfatte samtaler, praktisk støtte, hjemmebesøk, følge til avtaler og koordinering med kommunale tjenester, NAV og spesialisthelsetjenesten. Vi legger stor vekt på kontinuitet, tilgjengelighet, relasjon og tydelig ansvarsfordeling rundt den enkelte pasient.

jobs.title: IT Support to Paradox Interactive!
jobs.description:
Step into a tech adventure with Padarox Interactive! A unique opportunity for a gaming enthusiast to dive into a diverse role, tackling everything from software wizardry to hardware magic. Join a team that values your passion for technology and offers a vibrant, inclusive culture.

About the role

Paradox Interactive is one of the premier game developers and publishers of strategy and management games on PC and consoles! In this position, you'll play a crucial role in providing day-to-day technical support to your colleagues in the organization. You together with a team of 10 will provide seamless support to 800 colleagues in multiple global offices.

Responsible for day-to-day technical support, your role includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues both on-site and remotely. You play a vital role in the smooth onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring the seamless integration of hardware, software, and other services. Additionally, you take charge of the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment, ensuring a conducive environment for smooth operations.

You are offered

    Great culture with social hours, board games, and quiz nights
    A great role to deepen your knowledge within tech
    A dedicated consultant manager from Academic Work who will support and coach you in your future career

Work tasks

    Configure and troubleshoot software for seamless operations both on site and remote  
    Install and set up new computers, addressing hardware issues  
    Provide remote support to offices globally, contributing to a smooth tech environment  
    Collaborate with the support team on projects for infrastructure scaling and updates  
    Ensure the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment

We are looking for

    Work experience in IT support/IT related customer service
    Has an interest in hardware and technology
    Good knowledge of English in both speech and writing as it is used in daily work

It is meritorious if you have

    

● Worked in onsite experience in IT support previously

● Prior experience in networking and/or PC hardware troubleshooting

● Gaming interest

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Service-minded
    Curious nature
    Problem solver
    Adaptable

Paradox value attitude and personality. They seek individuals with a positive mindset, knowledge of technology, and a genuine interest in providing top-notch service. It's also important that you thrive in a culture where they embrace diversity in cultures, geographies, and languages.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Begeleider Nachtzorg
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de Stichting Pergamijn een Begeleider Nachtzorg in Echt.

Durf jij de uitdaging van de nachtzorg aan? ’s Nachts is de zorg allesbehalve voorspelbaar. Het ene moment is er rust, het volgende moment vraagt een complexe situatie om jouw kalmte, lef en daadkracht.
Jij bent degene die het overzicht houdt, de-escalerend handelt en aanvoelt wanneer zorg en nabijheid nodig zijn. Sommige cliënten zijn daarbij volledig afhankelijk van jouw verzorging of verpleging, waardoor jouw rol van onschatbare waarde is in de nacht.

De ene keer sta je er zelfstandig voor op onze buitenlocaties of tijdens mobiele diensten, de andere keer werk je samen op het terrein in Echt. Daarnaast wissel je de zorg af met het bemannen van ons beluistersysteem als centralist. Dankzij moderne domotica blijft jouw werk niet alleen uitdagend, maar draag je er ook aan bij dat cliënten precies de juiste zorg krijgen op het juiste moment en op de juiste plek. En als er calamiteiten of overstijgende zaken zijn, ben jij degene die het verschil maakt.

Werken in de nachtzorg vraagt iets extra’s van je, en dat zie je ook terug in de voordelen. Naast je salaris ontvang je een aantrekkelijke onregelmatigheidstoeslag, waardoor jouw inzet ’s nachts extra beloond wordt. Bovendien geeft het werken in de nacht je overdag meer vrijheid: tijd om te sporten, afspraken te maken of gewoon te genieten van je eigen ritme. Zo combineer je betekenisvol werk met een levensstijl
die jou energie en ruimte geeft.

-Jij hebt een afgerond diploma in de zorg dat gelijkwaardig is aan een Nederlands diploma MBO niveau 3 of 4 zoals Verzorgende, Verpleegkundige of Persoonsbegeleider.
-Jij hebt ervaring in de gehandicaptenzorg, jeugdzorg, ouderenzorg en/of psychiatrie.

jobs.title: Persoonlijk Begeleider
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Stichting Pergamijn in Echt een persoonlijk begeleider.

Pergamijn heeft oog voor mensen met een warm hart voor de zorg, die uitdagingen niet uit de weg gaan. We zien onze collega’s als professionals die waardevolle bijdragen leveren en met hun unieke kwaliteiten het verschil maken. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om dat talent verder te ontwikkelen!

Wat ga je doen?
Als persoonlijk begeleider ondersteun en begeleid je cliënten in hun dagelijks leven.
Je voert het ondersteuningsplan van de cliënt uit als team en samen met de cliënt en diens persoonlijke netwerk. Daarbij kun je rekenen op ons multidisciplinaire team van gedragsdeskundigen, medische en paramedische experten. Samen met jouw team gaan jullie de begeleiding en ondersteuning binnen deze woning vormgeven.

Waar ga je werken?
Bij Pergamijn werk je met verschillende doelgroepen binnen de gehandicaptenzorg,
waaronder mensen met een lichte verstandelijke beperking (LVB), matige verstandelijke beperking (MVB) en ernstige of meervoudige verstandelijke beperking (EVB/EMB). Daarnaast zijn er cliënten met complex gedrag of moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag (MVG of + groepen), die vaak intensieve begeleiding, structuur en
specialistische ondersteuning nodig hebben. De begeleiding is altijd gericht op eigen regie en het stimuleren van de mogelijkheden van de cliënt, met passende ondersteuning in zorg, wonen en dagbesteding.
Je komt te werken op één van onze woongroepen in Echt.

Je hebt een diploma dat vergelijkbaar is met een Nederlands mbo-4 of hbo-diploma in de zorg of sociale hulpverlening en ruime ervaring in de gehandicaptenzorg.

Je bent een zelfstarter met leidinggevende kwaliteiten, die makkelijk het overzicht behoudt en collega’s kan coachen. Je bent flexibel inzetbaar, communicatief sterk en schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende disciplines. Met jouw betrokkenheid en professionele aanpak zorg je voor kwalitatieve begeleiding en een fijne werksfeer.

Een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (Uittreksel Strafregister) en screening maken deel uit
van de sollicitatieprocedure.

jobs.title: Begeleider
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Stichting Pergamijn een begeleider in Echt.

Pergamijn heeft oog voor mensen met een warm hart voor de zorg, die uitdagingen niet uit de weg gaan. We zien onze collega’s als professionals die waardevolle bijdragen leveren en met hun unieke kwaliteiten het verschil maken. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om dat talent verder te ontwikkelen!

Wat ga je doen?

Als begeleider ondersteun je mensen met een verstandelijke beperking bij het invullen van hun dagelijks leven. Je helpt hen bij persoonlijke verzorging, dagelijkse activiteiten en sociale contacten, en stimuleert zelfstandigheid waar dat kan.

Je werkt vanuit een begeleidingsplan, signaleert wat cliënten nodig hebben en stemt je aanpak daarop af. Samen met collega’s en andere zorgprofessionals zorg je voor structuur, veiligheid en passende begeleiding.

Waar ga je werken

Bij Pergamijn werk je met verschillende doelgroepen binnen de gehandicaptenzorg, waaronder mensen met een lichte verstandelijke beperking (LVB), matige verstandelijke beperking (MVB) en ernstige of meervoudige verstandelijke beperking (EVB/EMB). Daarnaast zijn er cliënten met complex gedrag of moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag (MVG of + groepen), die vaak intensieve begeleiding, structuur en specialistische ondersteuning nodig hebben. De begeleiding is altijd gericht op eigen regie en het stimuleren van de mogelijkheden van de cliënt, met passende ondersteuning in zorg, wonen en dagbesteding.

Je komt te werken op één van onze woongroepen in Echt.

Je hebt een diploma dat vergelijkbaar is met een Nederlands mbo-3 of mbo-4 diploma in de zorg zoals Verzorgende, Verpleegkundige of Persoonsbegeleider. Ook heb je ervaring met cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking. Je bent zelfstandig,
verantwoordelijk en flexibel inzetbaar, ook buiten reguliere werktijden. Jecommuniceert duidelijk en hebt een warme, betrokken houding. Je signaleert veranderingen snel en werkt graag samen met collega’s en andere betrokkenen om de beste zorg te bieden.

Een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (Uittreksel Strafregister) en screening maken deel uit
van de sollicitatieprocedure.
