jobs.title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events
Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

Experience and skills
• Proficiency in Python for building and maintaining modular research tools
• Experience with dynamic system modeling or willingness to develop this quickly
• Comfort with multiregional input output analysis or similar economy wide model [...]

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with DFT codes (e.g. VASP, CRYSTAL, Quantum ESPRESSO or similar), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of magnetism, ferroelectricity and/or multiferroics is a strong asset.
• You are fluent in English, both oral and written. Knowledge of French is an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online
Your application must include:
• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• Academic record
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements

This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6'094 and €6'678, paid over 13 months (€79'222–€86'814 annually) based on fulltime employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined by the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.

• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

LIST is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on fabrication of the piezoelectric energy harvester based on ceramics for tires. The approach used for energy harvesting is the piezoelectric effect. Materials which show piezoelectric properties transform strain variation into electrical charge. These materials can be ceramics or polymers. The material chosen in this study is commercial PZT ceramics. To efficiently use the available mechanical energy in tires and induce strain in the piezoelectric material, it is essential to develop an adapted harvester's design, the transducer. In addition, harvester's signal conditioning plays an important role. To harvest enough electrical energy, all three points: material properties, harvester design and signal conditioning, have to be addressed.

This Postdoc position is mainly focused on development of energy harvester based on ceramics. Several challenges will be addressed to achieve targeted values of power from tires:
·        Investigation of geometries for an efficient transfer of strain from the tire into the ceramic. The design optimisation will be done using finite element modelling (Comsol)

·        Integration of the harvester into a real tire
·        Tests in the tire in operation

jobs.title: HR BUSINESS PARTNER (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
HR-26001 HR BUSINESS PARTNER

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO), bridging scientific excellence and applied research to address real-world challenges. With over 840 employees - more than 70% of whom are researchers, engineers, and PhD-level professionals working across Natural & Built Environments, Industrial Technologies, Space, AI, Security and Defence.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website.

How will you contribute?

Our HR team of 20 professionals covers the full spectrum: HR Administration, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, HR Projects, and HR Business Partnering. This last function currently comprises two HRBPs. Following continued organisational growth and increasing complexity, we are creating a third HRBP position - not to replace someone, but because the demand is real.

The role

The HR Business Partner operates with a high degree of autonomy under the general supervision of the HR Director.
This is an individual contributor (IC) role - you will not manage a team, but you will lead by influence, advise with authority, and build lasting relationships within a public research institution.
You will be the primary HR point of contact for a defined population of managers and employees (e.g. Head of Units, Group Leaders, Service Heads), supporting them across the full employment lifecycle — from recruitment validation to exit interviews, from salary review to contractual management. You will work side-by-side with HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, and L&D, but the accountability for your internal "client" perimeter is yours.
This is not a role where you execute a playbook. It is a role where you read the situation, navigate the rules, and find the right path - always within a well-defined legal and regulatory framework.

What you will actually do

Here is what you will spend your time on:

1. Conflict Management & Difficult Situation Advisory

This is the most demanding dimension of the role - not in volume, but in complexity, emotional weight, and reputational stakes. Your approach is fundamentally advisory: you coach managers on how to prevent tensions from escalating, and when a situation has already become critical, you guide them through a structured, legally sound resolution process. You distinguish between what requires immediate intervention and what requires patience. You document carefully, advise precisely, and remain steady when those around you are not. Working with highly educated, articulate professionals means that the people on both sides of a conflict are often skilled at constructing their argument - your job is to remain the clearest, calmest voice in the room.

2. Manager Coaching

You act as a trusted sounding board for managers navigating team dynamics, people decisions, and leadership challenges. This is not change management in the programme-delivery sense - it is the daily, relational work of helping managers think through situations, anticipate consequences, and gradually build their own HR reflex. You build your influence over time, not through authority, but through consistency, credibility, and genuine availability.

3. Recruitment Facilitation & Internal Mobility

You are the HRBP anchor in the recruitment process for your perimeter: framing needs with Hiring Managers, contributing to the annual recruitment plan, and supporting internal mobility decisions. You do not own the end-to-end recruitment process - that is the Talent Acquisition team's remit - but you ensure the right organisational decisions are made at the right moments.

4. Trial Period & Contract Monitoring

You actively track trial periods, flag risks early, and organise structured feedback conversations between managers and employees. You manage end-of-trial-period decisions with rigor and care. You conduct or facilitate exit interviews and ensure that what can be learned is captured. You have a genuine appetite for contractual matters - including the nuances of employment situation.

5. Luxembourg Employment Law - Applied Advisory

You are a reliable reference point on Luxembourg labour law and its practical application: CNS procedures (reclassement, medical visits), parental and family leave frameworks, absence management processes, and dismissal procedures. You do not just cite the rule - you contextualise it, assess the risk level, and give the manager and HRD actionable guidance, always within the legal and regulatory framework.

6. Annual Salary Review

You coordinate and manage the annual salary review cycle for your client perimeter, ensuring internal equity, policy compliance, and a smooth process across managers, HR Admin, and Finance. You are comfortable working with data - building and maintaining Excel dashboards, producing pivot-table-based analyses, and transforming raw data into clear decision-support materials for management. Advisory skills.

7. Performance Management Support

You oversee the annual appraisal cycle and provide advisory support to managers on objective-setting and performance conversations, ensuring process consistency - while remaining in an advisory capacity rather than a direct participant in those discussions.

8. HR Department Contribution

You contribute to collective HR objectives, participate in cross-functional initiatives, and actively represent the HR team's values in every interaction with your internal clients. You communicate through influence - not authority - and you understand that in a public institution, relationships are built slowly and lost quickly.

The Environment

We want you to know what you are signing up for:

Your internal clients are highly educated. Many are PhD-level professionals who are rigorous, analytical, and used to evidence-based reasoning. Vague HR advice will not land. You must be precise, credible, and consistent.
This is a public research institution. That brings strengths - stability, mission-driven colleagues, and genuine intellectual depth - as well as challenges: governance layers and decision cycles that differ from those in smaller organizations.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER ENGINEER IN AUTOMATION OF POWER CONVERTER DOMINATED GRIDS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Temporary contract | 24 months | Belvaux

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
You will join the Intelligent and Clean Energy Systems (ICES) research unit at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) and will actively contribute to the WeForming and EnerTEF project, funded by the Horizon Europe, in collaboration with research institutes and Industrial partners around Europe.

WeForming and EnerTEF focus on the use of Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs) in smart grids. In the case of WeForming, this includes the integration of energy storage systems together with smart electric vehicle chargers, while EnerTEF focuses on establishing Testing and Experimentation Facilities (TEFs) for the energy sector. Specifically, this project leverages industrial communication networks, distributed controllers, AI models, and state-of-the-art IBR-based infrastructure to optimize EV charging and energy systems. By integrating distributed energy resources, demand response, and storage, this project aims to enhance grid flexibility and increase the use of renewable energy.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Automating the operation and control of real demonstrators based on IBRs, including BESS, EV chargers, and PV generation, using distributed controllers (e.g. Beckhoff/TwinCAT, NI/CompactRIO, SIMATIC/PAC) and industrial communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, IEC 61850, EtherCAT, OPC UA, CAN/CANopen).
• Deploying cloud-to-edge architectures for real-time operation of IBR-dominated grids, integrating edge controllers with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS or GCP) using wide-area and publish–subscribe mechanisms (e.g. MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, OPC UA).
• Implementing distributed control strategies, including advanced services from grid-forming IBRs.
• Working with RT-HIL environments (e.g. OPAL-RT, Typhoon, dSPACE) to validate cloud-controlled systems interacting with real hardware.
• Participating in experimental activities in laboratory and field demonstrators with real-time data exchange and actuation.
• Disseminating results through technical publications and contributions to national and European RDI projects.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• A PhD's or MSc degree in electrical engineering, automation, computer science, or a related discipline, with proven expertise in the operation and control of smart grids.
Experience and skills
• Solid hands-on experience in designing and deploying automation and control architectures involving IBRs, distributed controllers, communication networks, SCADA, and cloud-based platforms.
• Experience in projects using cloud-based platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP), containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes), and middleware brokers (MQTT, OPC-UA, AMQP) to interact with distributed controllers.
• Practical knowledge of distributed control systems and real-time operation of smart and active distribution grids, including IBRs for battery storage, PV, and hybrid DERs.
• Familiarity with grid-forming control principles, converter modelling and deployment of real-time distributed responses to improve grid conditions.
• Experience with RT-HIL platforms (e.g. OPAL-RT, Typhoon), including closed-loop interaction with real hardware and field devices.
• Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, and experience with data-centric control and monitoring architectures.
• Experience working in interdisciplinary RDI environments and contributing to experimental demonstrators (lab and field).
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills suited for both technical and collaborative work.
Language skills
• Good level both written and spoken English

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 50 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy and access to lunch vouchers
• Access to state-of-the-art facilities, including the ICES RT-HIL simulation laboratory.
• Collaboration opportunities with leading researchers and industry partners in the EnerTEF project and beyond

Apply online
Your application must include:

• A scientific CV with contact details

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
jobs.description:
At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
Join Us

At Vodafone, we're not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we're shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you're part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What you'll do

The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies

Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonisation.

2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support

Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.

3. Supplier engagement & performance management

Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.

jobs.title: Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Notre client est un acteur reconnu de la promotion immobilière au Luxembourg, adossé à un groupe européen de référence dans les domaines de la construction et du développement immobilier. Dans le cadre de son développement, nous recrutons son/sa futur(e) Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière pour piloter l'activité luxembourgeoise.
S'appuyant sur un portefeuille de projets résidentiels et tertiaires déjà sécurisé pour les prochaines années, vous prendrez la responsabilité du développement de l'activité, du pilotage des opérations et du management des équipes, avec une large autonomie et le soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos responsabilités

En tant que Directeur/trice d'une Agence de Promotion Immobilière, vous assurez le pilotage global de l'entité, tant sur les aspects stratégiques qu'opérationnels.

Développement de l'activité

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de développement de l'activité au Luxembourg.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités et développer un réseau de partenaires (investisseurs, propriétaires, architectes, bureaux d'études, collectivités, clients...).
• Contribuer au développement commercial et à la commercialisation des opérations.
• Représenter l'entreprise auprès des principaux acteurs du marché immobilier luxembourgeois.

Pilotage des opérations

• Superviser les projets immobiliers, de la faisabilité jusqu'à la livraison.
• Garantir le respect des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coûts et de rentabilité.
• Piloter les procédures administratives et réglementaires propres au Luxembourg (PAP, autorisations de construire, etc.).
• Coordonner les équipes internes et les partenaires externes afin d'assurer le bon déroulement des opérations.

Gestion de l'activité

• Piloter l'entité comme un véritable centre de profit.
• Assurer le suivi financier des opérations, analyser les montages et accompagner les décisions d'investissement.
• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction Générale.

Management

• Manager et accompagner une équipe d'une petite dizaine de collaborateurs (Responsables de Projets, spécialistes techniques et fonctions administratives).
• Coordonner les intervenants externes (architectes, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle et autres partenaires).
• Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et accompagner le développement de l'activité.

Votre profil

Vous évoluez depuis plusieurs années dans le secteur immobilier luxembourgeois et disposez d'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la promotion immobilière. Votre parcours vous a permis d'acquérir une vision globale d'une opération immobilière, que ce soit au sein d'un promoteur immobilier ou à travers des fonctions de pilotage de projets complexes dans le secteur de la construction ou du développement immobilier.

Vous maîtrisez notamment:

• L'ensemble du processus de promotion immobilière, de l'acquisition foncière à la livraison des opérations.
• Les montages financiers et le pilotage économique de projets immobiliers.
• La gestion d'un centre de profit ou d'une activité disposant d'objectifs financiers.
• Les procédures administratives luxembourgeoises, notamment les PAP, les autorisations de construire et les relations avec les administrations.
• La commercialisation de programmes immobiliers et la relation avec les différents partenaires du projet.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à fédérer les équipes, à prendre des décisions et à faire avancer les projets. Vous appréciez évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial où autonomie, vision stratégique et pragmatisme sont essentiels.
Le français et l'anglais sont indispensables. La maîtrise du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Pour plus d'information, merci de contacter Nicolas Hurlin au +352 26 29 45.

jobs.title: Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) (Altenpfleger/in)
jobs.description:
Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d)

Inklusive Fahrkostenübernahme

Pflegen ist mehr als ein Beruf, es ist eine Haltung.

Und genau deshalb verdienst du einen Arbeitgeber, der das genauso sieht wie du. Bei BS Avalor findest du nicht einfach einen Job, sondern einen Partner, der dich kennt, der für dich da ist und der dafür sorgt, dass du dich auf das konzentrieren kannst, was dir wirklich am Herzen liegt: die Menschen, die du pflegst.

Als inhabergeführter Personaldienstleister mit langjähriger Erfahrung im Pflegebereich bringen wir dich mit Einrichtungen zusammen, die wirklich zu dir passen.

Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) – Inklusive Fahrkostenübernahme und ohne Probezeit

Das bieten wir dir:

- Übertarifliche Vergütung, weil gute Pflege ihren Wert hat
- Fahrtkostenzuschuss oder vollständige Fahrkostenübernahme, damit der Weg zur Arbeit kein Stressfaktor ist
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag ohne Probezeit, der dir echte Sicherheit gibt
- Einsätze, die zu deinem Leben passen, abgestimmt auf deine Stärken, deine Wünsche und deinen Alltag
- Verschiedene Einrichtungen kennenlernen und dabei immer einen festen Arbeitgeber im Rücken haben
- Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, weil du nicht stehen bleiben willst
- Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung, zum Beispiel über Urban Sports Club, denn wer andere pflegt, muss auch auf sich achten
- Eine Empfehlungsprämie, wenn du jemanden kennst, der auch einen guten Job verdient
- Persönliche Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) mit echter Branchenerfahrung, die nicht nach dem ersten Gespräch verschwinden
- Verlässliche Zusammenarbeit, bei der du weißt, dass du nicht allein bist

Was dich im Alltag erwartet:

- Dein Mittelpunkt sind die Menschen: Du pflegst und betreust Bewohner (m/w/d) oder Patienten (m/w/d) individuell, fachgerecht und mit echter Zuwendung, nicht nach Schema F, sondern so, wie jeder Mensch es verdient
- Mit sicherem Blick und ruhiger Hand führst du grund- und behandlungspflegerische Maßnahmen durch und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Menschen in deiner Obhut gut aufgehoben fühlen
- Du dokumentierst pflegerische Maßnahmen sorgfältig und strukturiert, damit alle im Team immer auf dem gleichen Stand sind und die Versorgung reibungslos läuft
- Im Austausch mit Angehörigen und multiprofessionellen Teams bist du eine verlässliche Stimme, die zuhört, kommuniziert und gemeinsam Lösungen findet
- Du bringst dich aktiv in die Gestaltung des Arbeitsalltags ein und trägst dazu bei, dass das Miteinander in deiner Einrichtung wertschätzend und professionell bleibt

Das bringst du mit:

- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d), Altenpfleger (m/w/d) oder Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger (m/w/d) und weißt, was in der Pflege wirklich zählt
- Ob Pflegefachmann (m/w/d), Krankenpflegehelfer (m/w/d) mit Weiterqualifizierung oder Pflegeassistent (m/w/d) mit entsprechender Erfahrung bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bei uns zählt, was du kannst und wie du bist.
- Du gehst mit Empathie und Wertschätzung auf Menschen zu, weil dir das nicht aufgetragen wird, sondern weil es einfach zu dir gehört
- Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich, und du weißt, wann es auf dich ankommt
- Ein Führerschein der Klasse B ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

Gerne stehen wir Ihnen unter Angabe der unten stehenden Referenznummer für Rückfragen zur Verfügung.

Die ETL AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft Steuerberatungsgesellschaft (kurz „ETL AG“) ist die Führungsholding innerhalb der „ETL Prüfung & Beratung Gruppe“. ETL Prüfung & Beratung gehört zu den Top 15 Wirtschaftsprüfungs- und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften in Deutschland.

**

jobs.description:
Einblick in die Position

Aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen entstehen bei uns durchdachte technische Lösungen und maßgeschneiderte Anlagenkonzepte. Dafür suchen wir einen Concept Engineer (m/w/d), der bereits in der Angebotsphase die technische Grundlage für anspruchsvolle Projekte im Sondermaschinen- und Anlagenbau schafft.

Aufgaben im Überblick:

- Aufnahme, Analyse und Aufbereitung von Kundenanforderungen und kundenseitigen Rahmenbedingungen (Infrastruktur, Abläufe, Vorschriften) in der Angebotsphase
- Prüfung von Kundenlastenheften auf technische Machbarkeit sowie Erarbeitung der technischen Antworten und diondo-seitigen Vorgaben
- Ausarbeitung kunden- und anwendungsorientierter Anlagenkonzepte in SolidWorks - Aufbau von Baugruppen aus bestehenden Modulen und Komponenten, ohne Detailkonstruktion
- Erstellung der technischen Unterlagen zum Angebot (Gesamtkonzept, Rahmenbedingungen, Konzeptdokumentation) für interne und externe Zwecke
- Mitwirkung an Konzept-Meetings mit dem Entwicklerteam sowie Zuarbeit zu Vorkalkulation und Risikobewertung
- Technische Abstimmung mit Kunden, überwiegend remote – mittelfristig mit eigenständiger Präsentation von Konzepten beim Kunden
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Projektleitung und den Fachbereichen Mechanik, Elektrotechnik und Automation sowie Softwareentwicklung
- Übergabe der Konzepte in die Produktentwicklung bei Auftragseingang sowie begleitende Unterstützung in der Umsetzungsphase

Anforderungen im Überblick:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder vergleichbar oder technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker/Meister (m/w/d)
- Berufserfahrung im Sondermaschinen- oder Anlagenbau von Vorteil; auch Berufseinsteiger (m/w/d) mit einschlägigem Schwerpunkt aus Studien- oder Abschlussarbeiten sind willkommen
- Fundierte Erfahrung im Umgang mit CAD-Software, idealerweise SolidWorks (oder alternativ: Inventor, Creo etc.)
- Gutes Verständnis mechanischer Systeme und die Fähigkeit, aus funktionalen Anforderungen tragfähige Gesamtkonzepte abzuleiten
- Bereitschaft, in der Angebotsphase mit unvollständigen Informationen zu arbeiten und zu belastbaren technischen Aussagen zu kommen
- Erfahrung in der industriellen Computertomographie, Röntgentechnik oder zerstörungsfreien Prüfung ist ausdrücklich willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung
- Eigenverantwortliches, selbstständiges und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten
- Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Sicherheit im Auftritt gegenüber Kunden
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das spricht für uns:

- Perspektivenvielfalt durch eine große Vielzahl an Branchen und Kunden
- Ein internationales und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld
- Gleitzeitmodell und keine Schichtarbeit
- Individuelle Weiterbildung
- Die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten in einem innovativen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln
- Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Kontakt zu uns

jobs.title: Experienced Insurance Manager (f/m/d) Liability / Financial Lines (Versicherungsprüfer/in)
jobs.employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

In close collaboration with your team, you will play a key role within the global insurance and risk management of Siemens Energy. Working closely with your team, brokers, and insurers, you will actively shape the placement of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs in the international insurance market, provide advisory support to business units on complex contracts, and manage challenging claims. Your daily responsibilities will integrate legal and insurance expertise, strategic business thinking, negotiation skills, and the ability to effectively communicate complex issues.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Responsibility for the design, placement, implementation, and management of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs, including the development of insurance terms and coverage concepts, considering the needs and risk profile of our business units
* Advising and placing liability project insurance
* Primary contact for insurance-related questions regarding contract structures and active participation in contract negotiations worldwide
* Supporting business units in reporting and processing insurance claims, as well as analysing and evaluating insurance solutions. Independently handling complex claims, with a particular focus on operational, product, and environmental liability claims, and managing claims processes abroad
* First point of contact for senior management-related questions regarding insurance coverage for the board and management in accordance with German corporate law

What You Bring

* Several years of relevant professional experience in a comparable position or relevant industry experience, particularly in the placement of international insurance programs, contract commentary, and claims handling in international project business
* Fluent in German (C1/C2) and English (C1), both written and spoken. Additional language skills, such as Spanish, are desirable
* Analytical skills and a confident approach to complex issues, connecting legal, technical, and economic aspects into clear recommendations
* Confident in negotiations, high level of personal responsibility, structured working style, and enjoyment of proactive topic advancement
* Proficient in all common MS Office applications and generative AI, with an affinity for implementing digital processes

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Outbound (m/w/d) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Worum es geht

Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %.

Du recherchierst Accounts, findest die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, sprichst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag.

Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung.

Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu.

Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, aber kein fertiges Playbook, das du nur ausführst. Einen Teil davon baust du selbst.

Aufgaben

- Accounts und Kontakte in definierten Verticals recherchieren, priorisieren und anreichern. Du baust deine Zielliste selbst — aber mit Clay und Cognism, nicht mit Google und Impressumssuche
- Ansprache über Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn. Cold Calling ist ein fester Bestandteil der Rolle, kein Randthema
- Eigene Sequenzen und Gesprächsaufhänger in Lemlist bauen, testen und wieder verwerfen, wenn sie nicht ziehen. Lemlist ist dein täglicher Arbeitsplatz, Clay und Cognism füttern ihn
- Erstgespräche buchen, sauber vorbereiten und mit belastbarem Kontext an die AEs übergeben
- Zurückspielen, was du im Markt hörst: welche Branche reagiert, welche Botschaft funktioniert, welche Einwände wiederkehren. Marketing und Sales-Leitung brauchen das
- HubSpot sauber und aktuell halten — nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern weil Pipeline-Bewertung und Forecast darauf beruhen.
- Enge Abstimmung mit Marketing und den AEs zu Kampagnen, Zielsegmenten und Übergabekriterien

Qualifikation

- Mindestens 1,5 Jahre Outbound-Erfahrung im B2B, idealerweise SaaS oder erklärungsbedürftige IT-Lösungen. Du musst nicht alles gesehen haben, aber du solltest den Job kennen und nicht bei null anfangen — ein spürbarer Teil dieser Zeit sollte am Telefon stattgefunden haben und nicht nur in Sequenzen. Das ist keine Einstiegsposition.
- Deutsch verhandlungssicher auf muttersprachnahem Niveau (C2), Englisch mindestens C1. Beides täglich. Der Maßstab ist das Telefonat: Du führst auf Englisch ein Kaltgespräch, reagierst auf Einwände und hältst den Small Talk davor und danach aus, ohne dass die Sprache zum Thema wird. Wir hören uns das im Prozess an.
- Du kannst nachvollziehbar erklären, warum deine Ansprache funktioniert hat — mit Zahlen und mit einer Begründung, nicht mit Bauchgefühl.
- Du kommst mit Geschäftsführerinnen und Inhabern zurecht. Im Mittelstand hast du häufig direkt die Person am Telefon, die entscheidet — und die dir drei Minuten gibt, bevor sie wieder in den Betrieb muss. Erst in größeren Häusern sprichst du mit Fachbereichsleitungen und gelegentlich mit der IT.
- Recherchefähigkeit: Du findest heraus, wer in einem Unternehmen ein Problem hat, bevor du zum Hörer greifst.
- Selbstorganisation: Du strukturierst deine Woche selbst und brauchst keine tägliche Ansage, um in die Aktivität zu kommen.
- Ein realistisches Verhältnis zu Ablehnung. Der größte Teil deiner Versuche führt zu nichts. Das ist normal und sollte dich weder überraschen noch aus der Ruhe bringen.
- Sicherer Umgang mit CRM und Sales-Engagement-Tools. Unser Stack ist HubSpot, Lemlist, Clay und Cognism — genau diese Tools musst du nicht kennen, vergleichbare schon.
- Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools. Recherche verdichten, Textvarianten durchspielen, ein Unternehmen vor dem Call in fünf Minuten verstehen — das geht heute schneller, wenn man weiß wie. Wir erwarten keine Zertifikate, aber auch niemanden, der ChatGPT einmal ausprobiert und wieder weggelegt hat.
- Von Vorteil: Du hast schon aktiv nach Großbritannien akquiriert und kennst den Unterschied im Gesprächseinstieg. Ebenfalls hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Low-Code/No-Code-, ERP-, CRM- oder Datenbankthemen.

Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als belastbare Outbound-Praxis. Wenn du das kannst, interessiert uns dein Studienfach nicht.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

- 60.000–65.000 € Zieljahresgehalt (OTE) bei einem Split von 70 % Fixum und 30 % variabel. Der variable Anteil hängt an Kriterien, die du beeinflussen kannst, und ist erreichbar geplant. Den Plan legen wir vor Vertragsunterschrift offen.
- Strukturierter Einstieg: Produkt, ICP, Einwände und Gesprächsleitfäden in den ersten Wochen — plus regelmäßige 1:1s und Call-Reviews statt Zurufmanagement.
- Kurze Wege. Du berichtest an Tim Genkinger, unseren Head of Sales, und hast direkten Zugang zu den Menschen, die über Produkt und Go-to-Market entscheiden.
- 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG-Ticket und weitere Benefits.
- Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte.
- Ein Stack, der die Arbeit tatsächlich trägt: HubSpot als CRM, Lemlist für Sequenzen, Clay für Listenaufbau und Anreicherung, Cognism für belastbare Telefonnummern. Dazu KI-Assistenz als fester Teil des Arbeitsalltags, bei uns Claude, für Recherche, Textvarianten und Call-Vorbereitung. Du verbringst deine Zeit mit Gesprächen und nicht mit der Suche nach Durchwahlen. Fehlt im Stack etwas, reden wir darüber.
- Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Ergebnisse sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass sie etwas bewegen.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

- Kein Inbound. Anfragen aus Produkt und Marketing laufen an anderer Stelle. Es gibt keine eingehenden Leads zum Nachfassen und keine Messelisten zum Abtelefonieren.
- Kein Closing. Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss liegen bei den AEs. Die Stelle ist als Outbound-Rolle ausgeschrieben, nicht als Durchgangsstation — wohin es danach geht, entscheidet sich über Ergebnisse und nicht über eine Zusage im Bewerbungsgespräch.
- Keine Führungsrolle. Du baust kein Team auf und führst niemanden.
- Keine reine Remote-Rolle. Wir hätten dich gern etwa zwei Tage pro Woche im Büro, im Haus sind das meist Dienstag bis Donnerstag. Mehr ist willkommen, weniger im Einzelfall auch machbar. Berlin als Lebensmittelpunkt setzen wir voraus.
- Kein Produkt, das sich von selbst erklärt. Ninox ist keine Wissenschaft — in einer Demo versteht fast jeder, was es tut. Der Aufhänger liegt trotzdem nie im Produkt, sondern beim Gegenüber: das Excel-Konstrukt, das niemand mehr pflegen kann, die Standardsoftware, die nicht passt. Darauf musst du Lust haben.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einer Ansprache, die funktioniert hat: wen du angesprochen hast, warum genau so, was dabei herauskam und was du daraus für den nächsten Versuch mitgenommen hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Unser Prozess besteht aus drei Terminen:

1. Erstgespräch mit Tim Genkinger, Head of Sales und Hiring Manager dieser Rolle.
2. Case Study. Du bekommst vorab eine Aufgabe und stellst sie Tim und Michael Blazek, unserem CRO, vor. Teile davon führen wir auf Englisch.
3. Meet the Team. Du lernst die Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen, mit denen du täglich arbeiten wirst.

Danach entscheiden wir. Wir halten den Prozess bewusst kurz und melden uns bei jeder Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

Ninox steht für ein Arbeitsumfeld ohne Diskriminierung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly (http://smartly.io/)  to learn more.

The processing of your information is described in our Candidate Privacy Notice (https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67ed4ab7f914accf87aa070c/698a11cb716926c1d76c1641_Smartly.io%20Group%20-%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Candidates%20-%201_2026.pdf) .

Diese Position ist bei uns weit mehr als eine klassische Assistenzrolle. Sie ist eine zentrale Vertrauens- und Steuerungsfunktion mit direktem Einfluss auf Effizienz, Qualität und die strategische Umsetzung unserer Unternehmensziele.

Ihre Rolle – Ihr Beitrag zu unserem gemeinsamen Wachstum 🌱

Als rechte Hand unserer Geschäftsführung sorgen Sie dafür, dass operative Exzellenz und strategischer Fokus stets Hand in Hand gehen.

Was Sie bei uns konkret bewegen:

- Geschäftsführungsalltag strukturieren: Sie halten der Geschäftsführung den Rücken frei und organisieren den Alltag so, dass strategische Zukunftsfragen immer Priorität behalten.
- Proaktive Termin- & Prioritätensteuerung: Sie erkennen Engpässe frühzeitig, setzen klare Schwerpunkte und schaffen gezielt Freiräume für unternehmerische Entscheidungen.
- Meetings vorbereiten & Beschlüsse umsetzen: Sie übernehmen die professionelle Vor- und Nachbereitung von Meetings inklusive Protokollführung und konsequenter Nachverfolgung. So werden aus Beschlüssen verlässliche Ergebnisse.
- Entscheidungsvorlagen & Analysen: Sie erstellen Präsentationen, Analysen und Vorlagen – fundiert, strukturiert und immer auf den Punkt.
- Souveräne Schnittstellenkommunikation: Ob intern zum Team oder extern zu Partnern – Sie kommunizieren verbindlich, charmant und stets auf Augenhöhe.
- Bereichsübergreifende Projekte koordinieren: Sie schaffen Transparenz, steuern Schnittstellen und begleiten Projekte zielgerichtet bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.
- Prozesse optimieren & digitalisieren: Sie bringen administrative Abläufe auf das nächste Level – effizient, skalierbar und mit Blick auf KI-gestützte Tools.

Der Gedanke dahinter: Vorausschauen, Entlasten, Mitgestalten – Sie bauen die Strukturen, die unserem Wachstum Halt und Richtung geben!

Das passt zu Ihnen, wenn Sie… 🌿

- eine ausgeprägte Organisations- und Priorisierungskompetenz besitzen und komplexe Themen konsequent zu Ende bringen.
- eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise lieben.
- selbst in dynamischen oder anspruchsvollen Phasen stets die Ruhe und Souveränität bewahren.
- Verschwiegenheit, Integrität und Loyalität als absolute Selbstverständlichkeit verstehen.
- Freude daran haben, administrative Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und effizienter zu machen.

Das bringen Sie mit ✨

Das ist unverzichtbar:

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Assistenz- oder Koordinationsfunktion.
- Ausgeprägte Umsetzungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, bereichsübergreifend zu denken.
- Klarheit, Wertschätzung und Verbindlichkeit in der Kommunikation.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Google Workspace und digitalen Projekt-Tools.
- Offenheit und Neugier für KI-gestützte Anwendungen und moderne Technologien.

Was Sie bei uns erwartet 💚

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Eine verantwortungsvolle Vertrauensrolle mit direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung.
- Innovationsfreudiges Umfeld: Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander auf Augenhöhe.
- Sicherheit & Perspektive: Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen.
- Zukunftsvorsorge & Benefits: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte.
- Persönliches Wachstum: Ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Ihre fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Ein Tag bei uns – so könnte Ihr Alltag aussehen ☕

Sie starten Ihren Tag mit einem frischen Kaffee und einem kurzen Abstimmungsgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Am Vormittag bereiten Sie eine wichtige Entscheidungsvorlage vor, analysieren Daten für das anstehende Quartalsmeeting und nutzen ein KI-Tool, um ein Protokoll strukturiert aufzubereiten. Nachmittags koordinieren Sie ein bereichsübergreifendes Digitalisierungsprojekt, klären offene Schnittstellen mit den Abteilungsleitungen und sorgen dafür, dass alle Fristen eingehalten werden.

Be- und Entladung unserer eigenen Fahrzeuge

Die positiven Rückmeldungen unserer Kunden und Mitarbeiter sind unser Motor, der uns antreibt. Sie können sich gerne die positiven Bewertungen unser Kunden und Mitarbeiter im Internet ansehen (mkbbetreuung.de) Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitern und unsere Kommunikation ist immer auf Augenhöhe.

Es ist eine erfüllende Aufgabe, unsere Mitarbeiter bekommen sehr viel Dankbarkeit von unseren Senioren zurück. Manche Kunden freuen sich schon die ganze Woche darauf, dass unsere Mitarbeiterin kommt. Endlich haben Sie mal jemanden, der sie bei den Aufgaben im Haushalt unterstützt und auch mal Zeit hat für ein Pläuschchen.
Für dieses Aufgabenfeld suchen wir neue Mitarbeiter. Sie können bei uns auf Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder auf geringfügiger Basis (Minijob) arbeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben:
•    Durchführung der Hauswirtschaft bei Kunden
•    Nach Absprache Durchführung von Fahrten mit Kunden (Einkaufen, Arztbesuche, Frisörbesuche)
•    Betreuung der Kunden
•    Unterhalten und zuhören
•    u.v.m.

Ihr Profil:
•    Erfahrung im Umgang mit pflegebedürftigen Menschen wünschenswert
•    Empathie für Senioren oder Menschen im Allgemeinen
•    Basisqualifikation gemäß § 45b und §45c SGB XI wünschenswert, jedoch nicht zwingend erforderlich
•    Führerschein der Klasse B sowie ein eigener PKW sind zwingend erforderlich
•    Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität

Gerne geben wir auch Berufseinsteigern die Chance, Teil unseres Teams zu werden. Die Basisqualifikation gemäß § 45b und §45c SGB XI kann über uns nachträglich erworben werden.
Der Stundenlohn liegt bei ca.14,50€, näheres im Gespräch. (Wir zahlen auch die Zwischenzeiten von Kunden zu Kunde bei vielen Betreuungsdienste wird diese Zeit nicht vergütet)

jobs.title: ICDP Science Coordinator (f_m_x) Education and Outreach (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: “Taking the pulse of the Earth to safeguard a habitable planet.”

For section 4.2 Geomechanics and Scientific Drilling (department'Geosystems ' (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) ), we are looking for a:

ICDP Science Coordinator (f_m_x) Education and Outreach

Reference Number 11530

The GFZ Section Geomechanics and Scientific Drilling hosts the Program Office of the International Continental Scientific Program (ICDP) (https://www.icdp-online.org/) , including the ICDP Operational Support Group and the ICDP Executive Directorate. ICDP´s mandate is to provide funding and support to multinational teams of scientists for implementing and realising scientific drilling projects on land around the globe. Since its foundation in 1996, more than 60 scientific drilling projects on six continents have been executed and completed with ICDP support and co-funding, and more than 90 ICDP workshops have been held. ICDP members are 22 countries plus UNESCO.

The successful candidate will play a central role in ICDP in developing new and continuing successful education events. They will also advance outreach to the public, media, the scientific community and ICDP stakeholders. This will include a broad target audience, from social media to scientific conferences and individual ICDP-funded projects.

Your responsibilities:

The successful candidate will work in the ICDP Operational Support Group and will be involved in activities in the following areas:

- ICDP outreach to media, public, scientific community, ICDP member and partner organisations (e.g. UNESCO, IODP, PAGES) and other stakeholders
- Planning and execution of international scientific training courses
- Development of online teaching materials
- Involvement of early career researchers in scientific continental drilling
- Advancement of ICDP social media activities
- Preparation and presentation of outcomes in scientific conferences, meetings, and journals
- The position is dynamic and will evolve in line with the requirements of ICDP

Essential Qualifications:

- A Master’s degree or an equivalent degree in Earth or Natural Sciences
- Outstanding communication skills and interest in working with scientific communities
- Work experience in science communication
- Experience in scientific teaching
- Outreach and social media expertise
- Background in Earth sciences
- Knowledge of ICDP or willingness to develop the necessary expertise over time
- Good communication skills in English, ability to speak or willingness to learn German
- Ability and willingness to travel internationally

Desirable Qualifications:

- A PhD is welcome but not a prerequisite
- Driving licence
- Expertise in drilling or borehole investigations
- Experience in developing and conducting scientific training courses
- Knowledge of emerging communication trends and future innovations

Start date: 1st January 2027
Fixed-term: 2 Jahre (mit der Option auf Verlängerung)
Salary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.
Working hours: Vollzeit (derzeit 39 h/Woche); Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilzeitgeeignet.
Place of work: Potsdam

What we offer:

- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Public service benefits
- Extensive training opportunities
- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre
- Flexible working hours and conditions
- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work
