    Kontakta kunder via telefon.
    Identifiera kundens behov och presentera rätt lösning.
    Arbeta mot individuella och gemensamma försäljningsmål.
    Utveckla din försäljning genom daglig feedback och coachning.
    Vara en del av ett team med högt tempo och tydlig prestationskultur.

Arbetstid: Måndag–fredag, 09.00–18.00.

Vi erbjuder

    Garantilön + provision utan tak.
    Säljutbildning från grunden.
    Daglig coachning och feedback.
    Möjlighet att utvecklas och avancera inom företaget.
    Möjlighet att arbeta inom både B2C och B2B.
    Hjälp med NIE-nummer, socialförsäkring och andra praktiska delar inför flytten.
    En internationell arbetsmiljö i Palma med kollegor från hela Norden.
    Möjligheten att kombinera arbete och karriär med livet på Mallorca.

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du kommer att trivas hos oss om du:

    Är social och trivs med att prata med människor.
    Är målmedveten och gillar att tävla mot både dig själv och andra.
    Har energi och driv att skapa resultat.
    Tar ansvar för din egen utveckling.
    Är uthållig och fortsätter även när något känns utmanande.
    Vill utvecklas inom försäljning och bygga erfarenhet för framtiden.
    Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift.

Tidigare erfarenhet inom försäljning är meriterande, men inget krav.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din inställning och vilja att lära dig.

En möjlighet att göra något nytt

Att börja hos Nordic Operation Center handlar om mer än ett nytt jobb. Det är en möjlighet att prova livet utomlands, bygga nya relationer och samtidigt utvecklas professionellt inom försäljning.

Du behöver inte ha det perfekta CV eller flera års erfarenhet. Vi söker personer med rätt inställning, ambition och vilja att skapa resultat.

Känner du igen dig? Skicka in din ansökan och ta nästa steg mot en karriär i Palma!

jobs.title: Bogholder til Skoda Nørresundby
jobs.description:
Bogholder til Škoda Nørresundby – få en central rolle i vores spændende hus

Er du skarp til tal, har du styr på detaljerne – og trives du med at have ansvar og overblik?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter som vores nye bogholder hos Škoda Nørresundby.

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst kollega, som får en central rolle i vores økonomifunktion. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og samtidig en tæt samarbejdspartner for ledelsen og kollegerne på tværs af forretningen.

EN ROLLE MED ANSVAR OG OVERBLIK

Som bogholder får du ansvar for en bred vifte af opgaver inden for økonomi og regnskab. Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

▪️ Daglig bogføring og finans ▪️ Kreditor- og debitorstyring ▪️ Bankafstemninger og betalinger ▪️ Momsafstemning og momsindberetning ▪️ Måneds- og årsafslutning ▪️ Løn og personaleadministration ▪️ Økonomiske rapporter og nøgletal ▪️ Afstemning af bilanlæg, lager og øvrige balanceposter ▪️ Kontakt til revisor ▪️ Løbende optimering og effektivisering af økonomiprocesserne

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt med dine egne ansvarsområder og har tæt kontakt til resten af organisationen.

ET LILLE HUS MED STORE AMBITIONER

Škoda Nørresundby er en mindre, men ambitiøs bilforretning, hvor vi kender hinanden og hjælper hinanden på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os er der kort fra idé til handling, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen.

Det gælder også økonomien. Vi har brug for en kollega, som ikke bare ser tal og posteringer, men som har lyst til at forstå forretningen og være med til at skabe struktur, overblik og gode processer.

Vi har en uformel omgangstone, et stærkt kollegaskab og en hverdag, hvor der også er plads til humor.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

▪️ Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling som bogholder ▪️ Har en relevant økonomisk uddannelse ▪️ Arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret ▪️ Er fortrolig med Excel og økonomisystemer ▪️ Har forståelse for regnskab fra A-Z ▪️ Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar ▪️ Er god til at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen ▪️ Har naturligt fokus på at skabe overblik og sikre, at tingene stemmer

HVAD FÅR DU HOS OS?

Du får en spændende og alsidig stilling i en forretning, hvor din indsats kan mærkes.

Vi tilbyder:

▪️ En central rolle med stort ansvar og indflydelse ▪️ Mulighed for at udvikle og præge økonomifunktionen ▪️ Dygtige og engagerede kolleger ▪️ En uformel hverdag med plads til humor og godt kollegaskab ▪️ Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling ▪️ Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Stillingen er på mellem 30-37 timer og kan således tilpasses dine ønsker og behov.

LYDER DET SOM NOGET FOR DIG?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og har lyst til at blive en del af Škoda Nørresundby, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til Torben Vinter: tovin@skoda-norresundby.dk

Alle henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller hverdagen hos os, er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Torben på 40 30 61 89 og tage en uforpligtende snak.

jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact.

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Cost Estimator HVAC to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Prepare and maintain cost estimates for products, services, and ship interior projects.
  • Analyze drawings, specifications, RFQs and other project documentation.
  • Identify and quantify materials, labour requirements and other project cost drivers.
  • Develop and maintain project calculations and technical proposals.
  • Collaborate with engineers, suppliers, customers and subcontractors to clarify project requirements.
  • Monitor actual costs against estimates and support cost control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain and continuously improve cost databases and estimation tools.
  • Participate in site visits and gather relevant information to support cost assessments.
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Knowledge of shipbuilding processes, materials and project costing.
  • Experience from the interior and/or HVAC industry is an advantage.
  • Technical understanding and commercial awareness.
  • Excellent Excel and general software skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
  • Able to maintain focus and perform effectively under pressure.
  • Adaptable and flexible in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Proactive and committed to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy

  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your caree

**Lapland Staff is looking for Car Drivers for the Christmas season 2026 to Lapland Safaris offices in Levi and Saariselkä.**

Please note that we are currently accepting applications **only from candidates who already have the right to work in Finland.** Unfortunately, due to the processing times for work permits and the schedule of our recruitment, we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require a new work permit to work in Finland. **This includes applicants from the UK, Australia, and other non-EU countries who do not already hold a valid right to work in Finland.**

The duties of a Lapland Safaris driver mainly consist of transporting, loading, and collecting equipment bags containing our guests winter clothing from local hotels and Lapland Safaris locations. In addition, your tasks will include supporting safari operations, such as sorting, maintaining, and drying equipment. Due to long distances, you may also occasionally transport staff between different locations, or between the workplace and staff accommodation.

The vehicles you drive will vary from passenger cars to vans, 9seat minibuses, and even vans equipped with a tail lift that can be driven with a category B driving license. Our working language is English, so good English skills is considered an advantage.

In addition to a valid driving license, we expect flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, as your workdays may sometimes be long. You are the person we are looking for if you are hardworking, proactive, well organized, and reliable.

The work is physically demanding and partly carried out in challenging weather conditions, including Laplands winds and snowstorms. You will work as part of a larger equipment maintenance team, and your contribution is highly important to the operation of Lapland Safaris.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- The beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits from Lapland Hotels & Safaris, including discounts on equipment rental, restaurants, and lift tickets at Lapland Ski Resorts.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. The work starts in mid-to-late November and is expected to last until the last week of December.

. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 11,30 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews and selections will be conducted already during the application period, so please apply soon! Positions will be filled as suitable candidates are found.

jobs.title: Factory Training & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**

Join Hitachi Energy in shaping the future of learning and growth! We're looking for a dynamic Factory Training & Development Specialist to lead impactful programs at our Transformers Factory in Vaasa.

The Transformers Business Unit is a core part of Hitachi Energy, enabling reliable power transmission and distribution worldwide. Over the years, the Vaasa factory has become one of Finland's largest and most important transformer manufacturing plant, contributing significantly to national energy security. Today, the factory develops and manufactures transformers that ensure electricity flows to millions of homes worldwide. The site operates in a complex manufacturing environment with high safety standards and a strong focus on sustainability, quality, and continuous improvement, serving customers globally both within and outside Hitachi Energy.

In this role, you will design and deliver innovative training experiences that empower teams, foster leadership, and drive operational excellence. If you're passionate about helping people unlock their potential and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real difference.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Drive factory training activities according to the agreed training roadmap, production needs and HUB guidance.

· Lead the practical implementation of Structured-On-The-Job training for direct workforce, including schedules, participants, trainers and documentation.

· Maintain course assignments, training records, certifications and completion data in the appointed Learning Management System (LMS).

· Prepare regular training status reports, dashboards or data extracts to support follow-up and decision-making.

· Coordinate with trainers and SMEs to prepare, update and validate training materials and work instruction related content.

· Follow up overdue, mandatory or certification-related trainings and escalate gaps when needed.

· Collect feedback from participants, trainers and stakeholders and drive agreed improvement actions.

· Communicate training schedules, requirements and practical instructions to relevant employees and managers.

· Provide accurate training records and evidence for audits, compliance checks and training documentation requests.

· Contribute to and drive continuous improvement of training processes, tools and ways of working within the factory.

**Your background**

· A B.Sc., M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, HR, Education, Business Administration or another relevant field

· Relevant experience in training coordination, production training, technical instruction, LMS administration or manufacturing support roles.

· Good understanding of manufacturing environment, shopfloor operations and competence development needs for direct workforce.

· Experience with Learning Management Systems, training data maintenance and reporting tools such as Excel and PowerBI is an advantage.

· Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, follow up details and maintain accurate documentation.

· Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder service mindset.

· Structured, proactive and quality-oriented way of working with a continuous improvement mindset.

· Familiarity with transformer manufacturing is an advantage.

· Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Directeur d'établissement hôtelier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) d'établissement hôtelier pour piloter l'exploitation et contribuer au développement de l'activité. Le poste s'inscrit autour de deux priorités : pérenniser et accroître l'activité hôtelière, puis remettre en place une activité bar dans des conditions adaptées à l'établissement.
Vos responsabilités
Management et ressources humaines
- Observer l'organisation existante, puis mettre en place des outils de gestion RH et optimiser les plannings.
- Optimiser l'utilisation des heures de travail et développer la polyvalence des équipes, notamment pendant les périodes plus calmes.
- Encadrer les opérations de nettoyage de fond et les actions d'amélioration de la qualité.
- Préparer et transmettre les éléments variables de paie au cabinet comptable, rédiger les contrats de travail si nécessaire et assurer les alertes administratives utiles.
- Construire et suivre le plan de formation, avec une priorité donnée à la sécurité incendie.
Exploitation et maîtrise des coûts
- Suivre la pertinence des commandes de petits déjeuners, consommables de bureau et produits d'entretien.
- Identifier les possibilités de réduction du gaspillage et de valorisation des surplus.
- Étudier les regroupements de commandes ou de contrats avec les établissements partenaires.
Expérience client, communication et e-réputation
- Encourager la collecte d'avis clients et systématiser les réponses aux avis publiés.
- Animer le site internet : offres, actualités et informations pratiques.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et à la cohérence de l'expérience client sur l'ensemble du parcours.
Qualité, maintenance, sécurité et gestion des déchets
- Mettre en place une méthode efficace d'identification et de suivi des pannes ou détériorations dans les chambres.
- Déclencher et suivre les réparations nécessaires avec les interlocuteurs concernés.
- Réaliser des contrôles qualité aléatoires de 5 à 10 chambres par semaine.
- Contribuer à la coordination avec le référent sécurité de l'immeuble et aux échanges avec les autorités compétentes.
- Organiser l'évacuation et le traitement des déchets non collectés dans les filières habituelles : verre, cartouches d'encre, appareils hors service et autres déchets spécifiques.
Développement commercial et optimisation du chiffre d'affaires
- Mener des actions de prospection auprès des entreprises locales et des organisateurs d'événements.
- Assurer une veille concurrentielle et contribuer à l'optimisation des tarifs hôteliers.
- Mettre en œuvre les principes de base du yield management avec l'appui des outils de réservation et de facturation existants.
Reporting et relation avec la direction
- Participer à une réunion mensuelle avec la présidente.
- Signaler sans délai tout dysfonctionnement important concernant le personnel, les clients, la sécurité ou les investissements à prévoir.
- Scanner et transmettre les factures papier, ainsi que les états mensuels nécessaires aux déclarations de TVA et de taxe de séjour.
Le profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée dans la direction ou la gestion d'un hôtel, d'un établissement d'hébergement ou d'une activité HCR.
- Solides compétences en management, organisation des plannings et accompagnement des équipes.
- Maîtrise des outils de réservation et de facturation ; une première expérience en yield management est appréciée.
- Rigueur administrative, sens du suivi budgétaire et capacité à travailler avec des partenaires comptables.
- Très bon relationnel, sens du service client, autonomie et capacité à prendre des décisions pragmatiques.
- Goût du terrain, esprit d'initiative et capacité à évoluer dans un cadre de collaboration souple et proche de la direction.
Ce que nous proposons
- Un poste central dans un établissement à taille humaine et à forte identité locale.
- Une réelle autonomie dans la structuration de l'exploitation et l'amélioration des méthodes

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.

Denne rekruttering håndteres af Randstad, og alle henvendelser bedes rettet hertil.

¤Om Evapco Europe A/S
Evapco Europe er specialiseret inden for produktion og udvikling af specialdesignede varmevekslere til en lang række brancher inden for bl.a. energi-, fødevare- og industrisektoren. Evapco Europe har fabrikker i Italien, Belgien og Danmark og er en del af en større global organisation med hovedsæde i Taneytown, Maryland, USA. Evapco Europe blev grundlagt i 1992 som Flex Coil, blev i 2009 opkøbt af amerikanske Evapco og består i dag af samlet 3.000 dygtige kolleger. ¤Om Randstad
Hos Randstad hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder med at udnytte deres fulde potentiale. Vi kombinerer viden med moderne teknologi for at skabe forandringer, der hjælper mennesker fremad. Vi kalder det Human Forward.

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de hot line en informatique
jobs.description:
Enreach for Service Providers développe la plateforme UCaaS sur laquelle les opérateurs télécoms à travers l'Europe font fonctionner leurs communications professionnelles. Nous sommes environ 60 personnes basées à Sophia-Antipolis, membres du groupe Enreach. Notre logiciel est utilisé par des centaines de milliers d'utilisateurs de téléphonie professionnelle. Ici, le support n'est pas une simple fonction de déviation d'appels. C'est le point de contact où la plateforme rencontre la réalité du terrain.

Vos missions :
Être en première ligne : répondre à la hotline de support, qualifier les tickets Jira entrants et effectuer le premier diagnostic réel de chaque problème avant qu'il ne soit transmis ailleurs. C'est vous qui décidez de l'urgence.
Accompagner nos partenaires EUPCloud : nos partenaires SaaS ne disposent pas de leurs propres équipes opérationnelles. Ils comptent sur nous. Vous travaillerez directement avec eux - via Jira, les canaux Teams, le téléphone - pour les guider dans la configuration et les aider à comprendre leur propre plateforme. Cette partie du rôle est nouvelle, et c'est la raison pour laquelle nous recrutons.
Savoir gérer efficacement :  lorsqu'un problème dépasse le niveau L1, vous le documentez correctement et assurez le suivi jusqu'à sa résolution. Ici, on ne se contente pas de traiter des tickets à moitié diagnostiqués.
Documenter les procédures : tout problème que vous résolvez deux fois aurait dû être documenté une fois. Notre base de connaissances est le levier qui permet à l'équipe de gagner en rapidité.
Monter en expertise avec le temps : vous commencerez par le triage. En l'espace d'un an, vous connaîtrez notre plateforme mieux que la plupart de ceux qui l'ont construite, car vous aurez vu toutes les façons dont elle peut tomber en panne.

Votre profil :

Maîtrise du français et aisance en anglais : vous travaillerez en français au quotidien. Cependant, nos partenaires étant répartis dans toute l'Europe, vous devrez également répondre à des appels de la hotline et rédiger des mises à jour de tickets en anglais. Votre anglais n'a pas besoin d'être parfait ou sans accent. Il doit être suffisamment bon pour qu'un ingénieur stressé à Rotterdam se sente pris en charge.
Quelqu'un qui aime le téléphone : pas quelqu'un qui le "tolère", mais qui l'aime. Guider calmement un ingénieur stressé à travers un problème, un vendredi à 16h, est une véritable compétence et est au cœur de ce métier.
Curiosité pour le fonctionnement des systèmes : vous avez cassé quelque chose, vous avez compris pourquoi, et vous l'avez réparé. Linux et Unix, le réseau, et idéalement une première approche de SIP ou VoIP - même s'il s'agit simplement d'un serveur Asterisk maison et de beaucoup de Wireshark.
Autonome : on vous donnera un problème, pas un script. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe de personnes expérimentées qui agissent vite et n'attendent pas qu'on leur dise quoi faire.
Quelqu'un qui tire les autres vers le haut : nous déboguons ensemble, nous nous enseignons mutuellement, et personne ici ne garde ses connaissances pour soi. Si cela vous semble évident, nous nous entendrons bien.

Les petits plus (atouts) :
Maîtrise de Linux (famille Rocky / RHEL) au-delà des bases.
Connaissance de SIP, RTP, et les joies spécifiques du débogage d'un problème d'audio unidirectionnel.
Capacité à scripter dans n'importe quel langage.
Allemand, néerlandais ou espagnol : ces langues sont un plus, mais aucune n'est obligatoire.

Jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine, une fois que vous aurez été pleinement intégré et que vous travaillerez en autonomie.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator in Product and Supply
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator – Product & Supply

Do you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and coordinating projects across different teams? Are you highly organized, analytical, and motivated by making operations run more efficiently? Then you might be our new Project Coordinator.

As Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in driving smaller projects and continuous process improvements within our Product & Supply organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across different departments to map, optimize, and maintain operational processes while ensuring consistency and efficiency throughout the supply chain.

Your responsibilities

As our new Project Coordinator, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate smaller internal projects within the Product & Supply organization

  • Drive updates and continuous improvements to operational processes and procedures

  • Map, document, and analyze current supply chain processes

  • Develop, align, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments

  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather input and ensure alignment

  • Support timely execution of both operational tasks and longer-term initiatives

  • Facilitate recurring process reviews and operational performance updates

  • Participate in process discovery and optimization workshops

  • Gather and analyze operational data to support reporting and decision-making

  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Who you are

We imagine that you are a structured and proactive professional who enjoys working with both people and processes. You are naturally curious and have a strong desire to understand how things work and how they can be improved.

Additionally, you:

  • Have a strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to problem-solving

  • Can manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously

  • Thrive in a dynamic environment and work well independently

  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across teams

  • Possess excellent communication skills

  • Have experience working with SharePoint

  • Have an interest in business intelligence tools and data analysis

  • Have advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data modelling

What we offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative and ambitious Product & Supply team where you can make a visible impact on how we work. You will have the opportunity to work across functions, contribute to important operational improvements, and develop your project coordination and process optimization skills in a supportive environment.

Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers:

  • A fantastic central Copenhagen location.

  • Attractive pension scheme.

  • Private health insurance (including children).

  • Flexible working, including the option to work from home.

  • A fun, social, and dynamic culture.

  • Events, Friday bars, staff clubs, and more.

  • An international workplace rooted in Scandinavian values.

  • Daily restaurant-quality food.

  • …and much more.

If this sounds like the right professional match for you, we encourage you to apply. Please include a short motivation text in the top of your CV – cover letter is not required.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotihoito, Tampere
jobs.description:
Lielahden kotihoidossa palvelemme noin 115:tä asiakasta kolmessa tiimissä. Teemme päivittäin tiivistä yhteistyötä tiimissämme toimivan erillisen P1-etähoivan yksikön kanssa. Moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistään arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä.

Lähihoitajana työskentelet kotihoidon vaativissa ammattitehtävissä ja vastaat asiakkaiden hoidon suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista. Työ on monipuolista, vastuullista ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden kodeissa sekä itsenäisesti että työparin kanssa ja teet yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, heidän läheistensä sekä muiden hoitoon osallistuvien ammattilaisten kanssa. Tiimitilamme sijaitsevat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella, aivan ratikkareitin tuntumassa. Asiakaskäynneillä voit liikkua yksikön autolla tai sähköpyörällämme. Jos käytettävissäsi on auto, voit hyödyntää myös sitä työssä liikkumiseen. Voimassa oleva B-luokan ajokortti ja mahdollisuus käyttää autoa helpottavat työssä liikkumista.

Tarjoamme sinulle
Laadukkaan perehdytyksen: pääset alkuun kokeneen työkaverin rinnalla.
Itsenäisen, vaihtelevan ja ratkaisukeskeisen työn sekä vahvan tiimin tuen.
Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi.
Lämminhenkisen ja avoimen työyhteisön, jossa vallitsee rento ja keskusteleva ilmapiiri ja työhyvinvoinnista huolehditaan yhdessä.

Odotamme sinulta
Olet sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilörekisteriin merkitty nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja tai perushoitaja.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisö- ja tiimityötaidot sekä valmius itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.
Sinulla on paineensietokykyä, kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa ja työn edellyttämä hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky.
Suhtaudut myönteisesti teknologian hyödyntämiseen hoitotyössä ja haluat kehittää työtä yhdessä muiden kanssa.
Sinulla on hygieniapassi ja tehtävän edellyttämät LOVe-lääkehoidon verkkotestit (LOP, PKV, GER1) hyväksytysti suoritettuina ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta.

Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian, sovimme aloituksesta kanssasi erikseen. Toinen tehtävistä päättyy 1.11.2026 ja toinen 10.1.2027. Koeaika on enintään puolet palvelussuhteen pituudesta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Tule mukaan reiluun ja rempseään työyhteisöömme tekemään merkityksellistä työtä, jolla mahdollistamme asiakkaillemme hyvän arjen. Jätäthän hakemuksesi Kuntarekry -rekrytointijärjestelmässä.

jobs.title: Junior IT Service Manager for energy sector, Espoo

Kotihoidossa työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja työskentelet asiakkaiden kanssa heidän omissa kodeissaan. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden päivittäisessä arjessa ja perushoidossa avustaminen

- lääkehoidon toteuttaminen

- sairaanhoidolliset toimenpiteet

- asiakkaiden voinnin seuranta ja palvelutarpeen arviointi

- kirjaaminen ja raportointi

- yhteistyö asiakkaiden, omaisten ja muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa

- työ on kaksivuorotyötä.


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Tehtävässä tarvitset lähihoitajan tutkinnon tai loppuvaiheen lähihoitajaopinnot. Lisäksi odotamme:

- voimassa olevia LOVE-lääkelupia tai valmiutta niiden suorittamiseen

- B-ajokorttia

- riittäviä ATK-taitoja

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta


Ensiaputaidot katsotaan eduksi.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- vakituisen työsuhteen

- TES mukaisen palkkauksen

- tarvittaessa koulutusta ATK-, LOVE- ja ensiapuosaamisen päivittämiseen

- monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn

- mukavan työyhteisön ja tuen työhösi


Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille jo tänään! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.

jobs.title: Project Engineer, ABB Marine & Ports
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Project Engineer to join ABB Marine & Ports and support the delivery of advanced marine electrical, propulsion, and control system projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career engineer who wants to develop technical expertise within a global engineering organization and gain hands-on experience in international delivery projects.

Your responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, you will:

- Support Lead Engineers in delivery project engineering and design activities
- Assist in technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle
- Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related engineering activities
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on system integration and troubleshooting
- Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and ways of working
- Support project teams in ensuring successful project execution and delivery

You will have the opportunity to work with systems such as:

- Generators
- Main switchboards and power distribution systems
- Transformers
- Converters and drives
- Propulsion Control Systems (PCS)
- Remote Control Systems (RCS)
- Dynamic Positioning (DP) systems
- Marine automation and control systems

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, we hope you have:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Good written and spoken English communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in an international project environment
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- Interest in electrical systems, automation, and engineering projects

Considered an advantage

- Familiarity with EPLAN or other electrical design tools
- Knowledge of IEC or IEEE standards
- Previous project, internship, or thesis experience related to electrical engineering or automation
- Interest in marine technology and power systems

What we offer

- Opportunity to work with world-leading marine technologies
- Exposure to challenging international delivery projects
- Great opportunities for professional growth and development

Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and interview suitable candidates during the application period. The position will be filled once a suitable candidate has been found.

Please note that, for GDPR and data security reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email or through other channels. To be considered for the position, please submit your application through our recruitment system on our website.

Vores projekter sprder sig fra vores base i vejle, til henover fyn, samt det meste af sjælland, og det forventes at være tilfældet de kommende år.

Du vil indgå i et fast sjak, som ligger ude mandag til torsdag på Sjælland. Bor du selv på Sjælland, skal du derfor forvente en arbejdsuge på 4 dage.

3TF ANLÆG A/S udfører jord-, kloak-, belægnings- og anlægsarbejder for både offentlige og private kunder. Vi vægter kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde højt, og vi investerer løbende i både medarbejdere og materiel.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Computer Science 

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. Our subject areas include hardware, algorithms, visual computing, AI, databases, software engineering, information systems, learning technology, HCI, CSCW, IT operations and applied data processing. The Department has groups in both Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Computer Science is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
jobs.description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja – tule tekemään merkityksellistä työtä kanssamme kotihoitoon**

**Haluatko sairaanhoitajan työn, jossa sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhösi?**

Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista ja kehitysmyönteistä työotetta, hyviä organisointitaitoja sekä ennen kaikkea halua tehdä laadukasta hoitotyötä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ainoastaan suorita työlistaa, vaan pääset ottamaan vastuuta, tukemaan muuta tiimiä ja osallistumaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilön kanssa ja olet tärkeä osa tiimin päivittäistä toimintaa.

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

- hoitotyön suunnittelua ja koordinointia

- lähihoitajien tukemista arjen työssä

- asiakaskäyntejä, kuten lääkehoitoa, haavanhoitoa ja asiakkaan voinnin arviointia

- hoidon laadun ja sujuvuuden varmistamista

- yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, omaisten ja moniammatillisen työryhmän kanssa

- toiminnan ja toimintatapojen kehittämistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa

- tiivistä yhteistyötä esihenkilön työparina


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme **vakituista työtä**, jossa työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin arkipäiviin. Käytössä on joustava ja autonominen työvuorosuunnittelu, joten pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- TES mukaisen palkan – kuulemme mielellämme myös palkkatoiveesi

- yrityksen auton asiakaskäynteihin

- työterveyshuollon

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa työnkuvaasi

- mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä yrityksen mukana

- työyhteisön, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä arki ovat tärkeässä roolissa


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Tehtävä sopii sairaanhoitajalle, jolla on hyvä asenne, organisointikykyä ja valmiutta ottaa vastuuta. Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme:

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- voimassa olevia lääkehoitolupia (LOVE)

- ajokorttia

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


Tehtävään valitulta edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ikäihmisten kanssa työskentelyä varten.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos etsit sairaanhoitajan työtä, jossa saat yhdistää käytännön hoitotyön, vastuun ja toiminnan kehittämisen, **haluamme kuulla sinusta!**

**Staffgate Oy** on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin.

jobs.title: Massører søges til  spændende virksomhed i Brande

jobs.description:
Til vores In House sundhedsklinik på international mode virksomhed i Brande, søger vi massører der har hjertet på rette sted og gode massagekompetencer

Der tilbydes et rigtig godt arbejdsforhold med velindrettede behandlingslokaler og mulighed for at modtage sparring og faglig udvikling.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bestå i at levere massage på briks.

Arbejdstiden tilrettelægges ift. behov og de dage der ønskes fra virksomhedens side.

Endelig arbejdstid koordineres mellem dig, Klinik.dk og virksomheden.

Opstart hurtigst muligt.

Ansættelse er i udgangspunktet som selvstændig konsulent med fakturaafregning (er du ny i dette hjælper vi gerne med opsætning)

Vi forventer du er mødestabil, åben og ligetil i din kommunikation og som sagt har hjertet på rette plads og fokuserer på at bidrage til øget sundhed på arbejdspladsen samt levere denne med bedst mulig kvalitet og selvstændighed.

Kort om Klinik.dk som har eksisteret siden 2007.

Hovedkvarter er belligende på Østerbro i København, hvorfra vi i dagleverer sundhed til virksomheder i hele landet og beskæftiger over 50 behandlere der hver dag bidrager med behandling, træning, vejledning og mange andre sundhedsydelser på nærværende og højt niveau.

Udover at levere sundhed, arbejder vi også med egen sundhed og har både social og faglig aktivitet internt hvor vi både mødes fysisk og online til workshops, webinarer og sociale sammenkomster og aktiviteter i løbet af året.

Kunne du tænke dig, at blive en del af Klinik.dk familien og samtidig for muligheden for at arbejde med sundhed på en forebyggende og velfungerende måde sammen med nogen fantastiske mennesker, så send endelig en ansøgning med CV afsted til mig.

Med venlig hilsen

Tenna Jørgensen 

Head of people & culture

jobs.description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
International School of Vantaa

Hagelstamintie 1, 01520 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 1.10.2026 - 31.12.2026

We are looking for a class teacher at Vantaa International School

The International School of Vantaa is a multicultural comprehensive school with around 680 students. The school provides English-language instruction for grades 1 - 9. The students' home language is English or they have acquired a good English proficiency by other means. The students are admitted to the school based on a language test. The teachers employed at our school come from various nationalities. Our curricula are based on the National Core Curriculum for Basic Education. Our goal is to raise well-behaving students with versatile general knowledge who can function in English in a global environment.

Our school is situated in the Aviapolis area, on the premises of the Point - Pakkala Learning and Information Centre, in Kartanonkoski. It is in Helsinki Region Transport zone B, and is quickly accessible. Buses from e.g. Sörnäinen metro station take about 25 minutes.

The International School of Vantaa is looking for a class teacher (Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, luokanopetus). The qualification requirements are higher university degree and class-teacher qualification (degree 986/1998). If the degree has been taken outside Finland, the applicant shall present an equivalent qualification approved by the Finnish National Board of Education.

We are looking for a teacher with good cooperation and communication skills and interest in further developing our school. We offer you a global work community as well as interesting teaching and education tasks in a modern learning environment.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
jobs.description:
Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle henkilökohtaisen avun pariin? Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on hyvä asenne sekä sosiaaliset taidot.

Haetaan henkilökohtaista avustajaa 27-vuotiaalle iloiselle ja puheliaalle miesasiakkaallemme Varkauden keskustan tuntumaan. Asikkaalla on downin oireyhtymä. Työtehtäviin kuuluu asiakkaan avustaminen vapaa-ajan puuhissa. Asiakas tykkää käydä avustajan kanssa mm. kuntosalilla, keilaamassa, uimassa, frisbeegolfaamassa, pyöräilemässä, lenkkeilemässä ja muutoinkin ulkoilemassa, kirjastossa ja ostoksilla. Käytössä olevina apuvälineinä kuulolaitteet ja tukipohjalliset.

Avustustunteja käytettävissä 30t/kk. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti iltapäivisin, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin tarpeen mukaan. Asiakas käy työtoiminnassa viitenä päivänä viikossa (ma-pe), jonka vuoksi avustustunteja voi olla vähemmän kuukaudessa, esim. 15-20t/kk voisi aluksi olla riittävä.

Lupaamme sinulle:

- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen

- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi

- lähiesihenkilön tuen

- monipuolisen työnkuvan

- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan

- palkkaluokka on G16A eli palvelusvuosien mukaan 13,20 € - 14,51 € / tunti (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)


Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kuopiossa, Joensuussa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, omaishoidon vapaa, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille. Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus.

jobs.title: Hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Nordecon Oy is converting a former industrial bakery building in Riihimäki into a data centre designed for AI and high performance computing workloads. Repurposing an existing industrial site brings interesting engineering problems a new build never has.

We are looking for a hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer to help us build it and then run it. You will be part of the core team in this role, which means you will not inherit someone else's procedures, you will build them.

Founded in 2006, Nordecon is an OEM and solution provider with nearly two decades of experience in mobile, server and custom-built desktop systems. The data centre is the next phase of that business.

**What you will do**

- Plan and oversee the installation of data centre infrastructure: servers, storage, networking and power systems

- Coordinate with vendors and contractors on procurement, installation, commissioning and acceptance testing

- Configure, integrate and troubleshoot systems to keep them performing

- Work with environmental and monitoring systems — cooling, power distribution, alarms

- Carry out site assessments and make sure we meet safety and industry standards

- Write and maintain the documentation: design records, installation procedures, and the operating procedures the site will run on

- Take part in our ISO/IEC 27001 certification work. Building the operational procedures and controls that certification is based on, not just following them

- As the team grows, support and guide our data centre technicians


**What helps you succeed in this role**

- Hands-on experience deploying and operating data centre infrastructure

- Solid understanding of network and data cabling, and of network and power capacity planning

- Strong Linux skills

- Working knowledge of HVAC and cooling dynamics in a data centre context

- Fluent Finnish and good English

- A degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field or equivalent experience earned on the job

- Willingness to be on site in Riihimäki, and to take part in an on-call rotation once the site is live


**Nice to have**

- Experience converting or retrofitting an existing building for data centre or other critical facility use

- Experience commissioning a new site or a major capacity expansion

- Liquid-cooled or high-density deployments

- Exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or similar management systems

- Electrical or HVAC qualifications


We offer you a permanent full-time position with interesting and versatile tasks with the opportunity to have a real influence on the development of the data center. The applicant must speak Finnish. If you got interested and would like to know more please send your questions, introductions and CV with salary request to applications@nordecon.fi

We read every application, but we are a small team and receive a high volume of them. We will only contact candidates we invite to interview. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, the role has moved forward with other candidates. We know applying takes real effort, and we appreciate the time you put into it.

jobs.title: Tukiperhe

Tukiperhetoiminta on tarkoitettu tueksi lapsiperheelle, jossa tarvitaan apua arjen helpottamiseksi kuormittavassa elämäntilanteessa tai johtuen lapsen erityisen tuen tarpeista.

Tukiperhe voi olla lapseton pariskunta, pariskunta, jolla on kotona asuvia lapsia tai yksinasuvan aikuisen perhe, jolla on resursseja ja halua tarjota huolenpitoa sekä turvaa lapsille ja nuorille. Koska lasten ja perheiden tilanteet ja tukitarpeet ovat erilaisia, toimintaan tarvitaan eri-ikäisiä, kulttuuritaustaltaan vaihtelevia ja monenlaisia taitoja omaavia tukiperheitä, jotka voivat vastata lapsen ja perheen tarpeisiin.

Etsimme tukiperheitä erityisesti Uudenmaan alueelta sekä Mikkelin seudulta. Myös muualla asuvat olkaa yhteydessä niin pohditaan tilannettanne.

Lapsi viettää tukiperheessä yleensä yhden viikonlopun kuukaudessa ja loma-aikoina sovitulla tavalla. Tukiperheessä tehdään tavallisia, turvallisen arkisia asioita. Tukiperheen aikuisilla tulisi olla mahdollisuus kuljettaa lasta tukiviikonlopuille ja takaisin kotiin. Tukiperheen oma elämäntilanne on vakaa, perheessä ei ole akuutteja kriisejä tai muita suuria huolia.

AVA valmentaa tukiperheet ja antaa vahvaa tukea koko lapsen tukisuhteen ajan.

- säännöllinen yhteydenpito sekä 24 h puhelinpäivystystuki

- kasvatuskumppanuus arjen haastaviin tilanteisiin

- sosiaalityöntekijän ohjaus- ja konsultaatiopalveluja
