jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

Description du poste :

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Applications pour assurer l'interface technique principale entre les clients, les partenaires système et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora. Ce rôle combine accompagnement client, support technique, intégration de plateformes et résolution de problèmes au niveau système, afin d'assurer le succès du déploiement des solutions IA basées sur l'accélérateur Vsora.

Vos responsabilités Servir de pont entre les clients et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora, assurant une communication efficace et la priorisation des problèmes techniques. Traduire les exigences clients, les demandes de fonctionnalités et les défis de déploiement en retours actionnables pour les équipes Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de validation logicielle, runtime, compilateur, logiciel IA et matériel pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer le produit Suivre et gérer les escalades clients jusqu'à leur résolution, en maintenant une communication claire avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes Accompagner les fabricants de serveurs, OEM, ODM et partenaires plateforme dans l'intégration des accélérateurs Vsora dans des systèmes de production. Résoudre les problèmes au niveau système impliquant le matériel, le firmware, les drivers, le réseau, le stockage, l'alimentation et la thermique Collaborer avec les équipes hardware pour diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes d'intégration plateforme et d'interopérabilité.

Description du profil Solide expérience en support technique, ingénierie terrain (FAE), solutions engineering, ingénierie client ou intégration système Expérience en infrastructure IA, serving d'inférence, déploiement ML ou plateformes datacenter Familiarité avec les frameworks IA et solutions de serving : PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server ou technologies équivalentes Expérience avec les systèmes Linux, les technologies de containerisation, les systèmes distribués. Compréhension de l'architecture serveur, des accélérateurs PCIe et de l'infrastructure datacenter Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et débogage : hardware, firmware, drivers, systèmes d'exploitation et logiciels applicatifs Excellentes capacités de communication et de relation client, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non-techniques Expérience avec des OEM, ODM, hyperscalers, cloud providers ou clients enterprise est un fort atout.

Partner & Client Services - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

jobs.title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

Pay Transparency Statement:  The salary range for this position is 116340 - 186144 EUR / year.

The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. jobs.description:
Valuation Officer

Hybrid
Luxembourg, Airport Centre
Full time
JR-0022166

FundRock LIS S.A. is a successful third-party UCITS management company and AIFM headquartered in Luxembourg and with an office in Dublin, delivering fund solutions to renowned investment managers and fund initiators.

Founded in 2011, we focus on private equity, real estate, infrastructure and debt asset classes. Today we are the leading third-party AIFM in the private funds space.

In September 2022, our company was acquired by Apex Group. Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With over 13,000 employees globally, Apex Group provides services into 50 jurisdictions delivering an expansive range of services to asset managers, financial institutions, private clients, and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry; including fund raising solutions, fund administration, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody, super ManCo, corporate services and a pioneering ESG and sustainability services. Apex Group's purpose is to be more than just a financial services provider and is committed to driving positive change to address three core areas; the environment and climate change, women's empowerment and economic independence, education and social mobility.

Role: AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager
Role Location: Luxembourg (Airport Center)
Employment Type: Permanent

Role summary:

Join our team as an AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager, where you'll play a key role in managing risk and valuations for alternative investment funds like private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. You'll work with advanced risk models, prepare reports for senior stakeholders, and support clients in setting up funds. This is a great opportunity to apply your analytical skills, grow your expertise, and make an impact in a dynamic, international environment.

Key responsibilities:

• Day-to-day risk management for alternative investment fund products (AIFs).
• Periodic review of valuations of alternative assets (private equity, real estate, infrastructure, debt instruments, etc.).
• Applying risk management tools and models to alternative investment funds (private equity, real estate, infrastructure, debt etc.).
• Compilation of risk management reports to senior management, fund boards and the regulator CSSF.
• Assisting clients in fund setup in relation to risk management and valuation aspects, data standards and monitoring topics.
• Regular review of risk management and valuation processes of AIFs.

Skills / experience:

• First experience in risk management/investment controlling for alternative investment funds or as a consultant/auditor of alternative investment funds at a major consulting/audit firm (“Big 4”).
• Strong academic background in Finance, Business Administration, or Business Informatics/ Applied Mathematics.
• Strong analytical and conceptual skills with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.
• Risk/Financial modelling and analysis skills.
• Computer literate with sound Excel and MS-Office skills.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken).
• You are a team player with pro-active work-ethics, and you enjoy challenges.

Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the hiring process once a job offer has been made. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

As a vital team member and in return for your expertise, inclusive approach and commitment, we'll provide a favourable salary and the chance to join a passionate and welcoming team. jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta učitelja/učiteljice razredne nastave na talijanskom jeziku u produženom boravku na neodređeno i puno radno vrijeme – 2 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice, uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20) i temeljem Odluke o organizaciji i provedbi produženog boravka i cjelodnevnog odgojno-obrazovnog rada u osnovnim školama Grada Rijeke („Službene novine Grada Rijeke“ broj 4. – godina XII): - završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20) e secondo la Decisione sull'organizzazione e sullo svolgimento del doposcuola e della scuola a tempo pieno nelle scuole elementari della Città di Fiume (Gazzetta ufficiale della Città di Fiume n. 4 – anno XII): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17).   • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: UREĐIVAČ/ICA VIDEOZAPISA / SADRŽAJA ZA DRUŠTVENE MREŽE
jobs.description:
Tražimo junior content creatora / video editora Rvstica (sapunerija.com) traži vrijednu i odgovornu osobu koja voli snimati i montirati video sadržaj. Moguće korištenje mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja. Uvjeti radnog mjesta:
  • Puno radno vrijeme
  • Fleksibilno radno vrijeme
  • Plaća 1100 eura neto, dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije ostvarene putem videa koje osoba snimi i montira.
  • Početak rada 1.10. 2026.
  • Potreban vlastiti prijevoz, zato je dobro imati osobni automobil.
Opis posla:
  • Snimanje kratkih video sadržaja za Reels, TikTok i Stories: proizvodnja sapuna, uživo radionice izrade sapuna, priroda, "behind the scenes", UGC videi s korištenjem proizvoda, priče o proizvodu.
  • Montiranje videa u CapCutu, uz dinamične rezove, titlove i ubacivanje slika.
  • Pisanje scenarija prema zadanim edukacijama, uz praćenje trendova na Instagramu i TikToku i predlaganje ideja za sadržaj.
  • Snimanje se odvija u Tučepima, dok se video montaža radi kod kuće.
Koga tražimo:
  • Osobu s osjećajem za vizualno pripovijedanje i ritam montaže, s iskustvom ili jakim interesom za CapCut i format Reels/TikTok.
  • Kreativnu, samoinicijativnu osobu s okom za detalje, vrijednu i marljivu, spremnu puno učiti i savladati edukacije koje odredimo. Prethodno profesionalno iskustvo nije potrebno.
  • Poželjno je poznavanje osnova marketinga društvenih mreža, fotografije i rada s kamerom, mobitel je dovoljan za početak. Zanimanje za prirodnu kozmetiku, održivost i "slow living" estetiku predstavlja prednost ali nije nužno.
Poslodavac nudi:
  • Rad na autentičnom, vizualno bogatom terenu (proizvodnja sapuna, maslinici, radionice izrade sapuna, konoba), kreativnu slobodu u oblikovanju sadržaja, plaćene edukacije video editinga i marketinga općenito, te dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije videa.
  • Osobi koja pokaže rezultate i želju za razvojem nudimo mogućnost napredovanja unutar brenda, povećanje plaće uz kontinuirano mentorstvo i vođenje kroz edukacije.
Prijave slati na mail

jobs.title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.title: Erfaren cykelmekaniker med sans for salg søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger ikke bare en mekaniker – vi søger den person, der kan blive butikkens ansigt udadtil og tage ansvar, som var det sin egen forretning.

Er du en dygtig og selvstændig cykelmekaniker med solid erfaring? Trives du med ansvar, kundekontakt og en varieret hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at få butikken til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker, der kan tage ansvar for både butik og værksted i det daglige. Du skal være tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt og kunne håndtere alt fra almindelige serviceeftersyn til fejlfinding og større reparationer på alle typer cykler, herunder ladcykler - har du erfaring med elcykler, er det et plus.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Har flere års erfaring som cykelmekaniker.

* Kan diagnosticere og løse alle typer mekaniske problemer på cykler.

* Er vant til at arbejde alene og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver.

* Er serviceminded og god til at rådgive kunder.

* Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og med fokus på kvalitet.

* Forstår at mersalg er en del af servicen.

Vi tilbyder

* En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

* En varieret hverdag i en lille, lokal cykelbutik i Søborg.

* Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift.

* Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

* Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en butik, hvor godt håndværk og god kundeservice er i fokus. Vi sætter pris på vores ⭐️'er.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV på mailen nedenunder. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Michelle Rasmussen

JM Cykler

kontakt@jmcykler.dk

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Public Sector - East
Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

jobs.title: Vastaava Sairaanhoitaja Liedon Kreivinkotoon!
jobs.description:
**Emme etsi täydellistä sairaanhoitajaa. Etsimme sinua.**

**Liedon Kreivinkoto etsii vastaavaa sairaanhoitajaa, jolla on vankkaa kokemusta hoitotyöstä ikäihmisten parissa, rohkeutta johtaa arjen hoitotyötä, sydäntä kohdata ja halua tehdä asioita vähän paremmin.**

Jos pelkkä titteli ei sinua innosta, mutta ajatus siitä, että voisit oikeasti vaikuttaa ihmisten arkeen, saa sinut kiinnostumaan – jatka lukemista.

**Tässä työssä saat olla ihminen ihmisille.**

Vastaavana sairaanhoitajana olet lähellä sekä asukkaita että työyhteisöä. Pidät hoitotyön langat käsissäsi, tuet henkilöstöä, huolehdit laadukkaasta ja turvallisesta hoivasta sekä viet toimintaa rohkeasti eteenpäin. Mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse tehdä itse. **Hyvä vastaava sairaanhoitaja ei kerää kaikkea itselleen, vaan hän saa muut loistamaan.** Siksi haluamme sinut, joka kuuntelet, kannustat, uskallat puuttua ja ennen kaikkea olet aidosti läsnä. **Meillä saa olla huumoria. Mielellään myös maanantaisin.**

Haluamme rakentaa Kreivinkotoon työyhteisön, jossa saa olla oma itsensä. Sellaisen, jossa kysyminen on sallittua, apua saa pyytää ja onnistumisista iloitaan yhdessä. Työ on tärkeää ja välillä vaativaa – mutta sen ei tarvitse olla ankeaa.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

Olet **laillistettu sairaanhoitaja**, jolla on:

- rohkeutta ottaa vastuuta

- kykyä pitää kokonaisuudet hallussa

- hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot

- halua kehittää hoitotyötä ja työyhteisöä

- lämmin ja kunnioittava tapa kohdata ihmiset.


Aiempi kokemus vastuutehtävistä tai esihenkilötyöstä on plussaa.

**Persoona ratkaisee kuitenkin enemmän kuin täydellinen ansioluettelo.**

**Miksi juuri Kreivinkoto?**

Koska täällä et ole vain yksi nimi työvuorolistassa. Haluamme kuulla ajatuksesi.

Haluamme, että uskallat sanoa: _"Voitaisiinko tehdä tämä toisin?"_

Ja vielä parempi, jos jatkat: _"Minä voin kokeilla."_

Saat vastuuta, mutta myös tukea. Saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, mutta et joudu kantamaan kaikkea yksin. Ja joka päivä saat tehdä työtä, jolla on ihan oikeasti merkitystä.

**Jos sinussa on vähän kapinallista hoitajaa, vähän johtajaa ja paljon sydäntä – saatamme etsiä juuri sinua.**

**Tule Kreivinkotoon. Tehdään yhdessä työpaikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla.**

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Koivukylän alueelle Vantaalle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Koivukylän alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Tikkurilan alueelle Vantaalle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Tikkurilan alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


**Edellytämme sinulta**

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

jobs.title: Planning Engineer
jobs.description:
Enersense Engineering is currently looking for Planning Engineers to join our clients data centre project in Helsinki, Finland. Work will start in the beginning of November 2026.

In this role, you will support the Planning Lead in coordinating project planning activities, including scheduling, progress tracking and reporting. You will work closely with project teams, contractors and other stakeholders, helping ensure that project timelines, resources and deliverables remain on track. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a large-scale project and gain valuable experience in a dynamic project environment.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
* Develop, maintain and update project schedules, including Level I–III schedules and the overall master schedule.
* Support baseline development, progress measurement and weekly/monthly reporting.
* Coordinate schedules and progress information from multiple contractors and integrate them into the overall project schedule.
* Monitor and forecast progress, identify potential delays and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyse critical paths and develop alternative scheduling solutions to support project execution.
* Develop and maintain plan-versus-actual curves, histograms and progress reports, analysing deviations from the plan.
* Monitor resource allocation and provide recommendations to maintain project progress.
* Coordinate key dates, interfaces and planning activities between project teams, contractors and other stakeholders.
* Collect and analyse progress data, actual dates and work-hour information.
* Participate in the analysis of contractor progress updates and schedules.
* Prepare and issue updated schedules, dashboards and weekly/monthly reports.

Requirements:
* Experience in project planning, scheduling or project controls, preferably in large-scale construction, industrial or data centre projects.
* Good working knowledge of Primavera P6.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with progress measurement, schedule analysis and contractor coordination.
* Ability to identify risks and deviations and recommend practical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Structured and detail-oriented approach to planning and reporting.
* Ability to work independently while being an effective member of a multidisciplinary project team.

We understand that relocating for a new opportunity is a major decision. To support a smooth transition, we can assist international candidates with the relocation process to Finland.

We follow pay transparency principles and the salary level and the criteria used to determine it will be communicated to candidates before the interview.

Due to GDPR regulations, applications will only be accepted through our official application system.

We manage this recruitment process internally and therefore do not require support from external recruitment agencies.

If you have any questions, please contact: Sanna Uronen, HR Coordinator, +358 40 176 5270, sanna.uronen@enersense.com

We are Enersenses Expert Services team. We deliver qualified and compliant workforce solutions for our clients' demanding technical and engineering projects locally and internationally. jobs.title: Kundservicemedarbetare på Mallorca - Dag/Natt
jobs.description:
Har du service i fokus, gillar att hjälpa andra och vill ha en vardag i solen nu när hösten närmar sig?

Vår kundserviceavdelning fortsätter att växa och därför söker vi nu fler kollegor med start under höst och vintern 2026. Totalt 15 platser ska tillsättas till vårt kontor i Palma de Mallorca. Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i din karriär eller upptäcka livet utomlands.

Hos Nordic Operation Center arbetar vi med både kundservice och telefonförsäljning för några av Nordens starkaste varumärken. Vi har byggt en prestationsdriven miljö med tydliga mål, tävlingar och en stark teamkultur.

Tänk dig att avsluta arbetsdagen och kunna ta en promenad längs stranden, träna i solen eller äta middag i Palma tillsammans med dina nya kollegor, här kombinerar du karriär med livsstil.

Anställning kommer att ske löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansöka, kanske är det just dig vi söker!

Om rollen

Som kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du med inkommande kundärenden via telefon. Du hjälper kunder på ett professionellt och effektivt sätt, där kvalitet och bemötande alltid står i fokus.

I rollen kan arbetstiderna variera mellan dag, kväll och natt beroende på vilket projekt du tilldelas.

Arbetet innebär bland annat att:

    Hantera bokningar och avbokningar
    Hjälpa både privat- och företagskunder
    Arbeta mot tydliga mål kopplade till kundnöjdhet och effektivitet

Du blir en viktig del av teamet där din insats direkt påverkar både kundupplevelsen och resultatet.

Vi erbjuder

    Heltidstjänst med stegrande lön
    20 dagars betald semester per år
    Betald introduktion och utbildning
    Möjlighet att utvecklas och göra karriär inom bolaget
    En arbetsplats med stark gemenskap och högt engagemang
    Möjlighet att bo och arbeta i Spanien
    Hjälp med spanska dokument (NIE & socialförsäkring)
    Bostadshjälp där vi hjälper dig med kontaktuppgifter till både mäklare och hyresvärdar.

Vi söker dig som

    Är noggrann, strukturerad och stresstålig
    Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo
    Är bekväm med telefon och dator som arbetsverktyg
    Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift samt har grundläggande engelska
    Är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter verksamhetens behov

Är du rätt person för jobbet?

Tjänsten passar dig som är redo att göra något nytt, hitta en ny vardag eller utvecklas snabbt inom kundservice. Du är positiv, målinriktad och arbetar effektivt mot uppsatta mål med hög kvalité. Den viktigaste pelaren på Nordic Operation Center är vår kultur. Vår vision är att bygga ett andra hem för vårt team där vi alltid sätter våra medarbetare i fokus.

Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande men inget krav. Är du vårt nästa stjärnskott eller har du det som krävs för att bli det? Vi söker efter nya stjärnor men vi är också med och skapar dem från grunden!

jobs.title: Auton fiksaus ja korjaus

Etsimme yritykseemme monipuolista ja motivoitunutta autoalan työntekijää. Yrityksemme tarjoaa auton pesu-, puhdistus- ja viimeistelypalveluita sekä teemme tarpeen mukaan erilaisia autojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on käytännön kokemusta useista autoalan työtehtävistä ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti sekä huolellisesti.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Vähän ymmärrystä sähköautoista.

\* autojen ulkopesu ja perusteellinen puhdistus

\* autojen sisäpuhdistus ja detailing

\* auton maalipinnan kiillotus ja myllytys

\* maalipinnan viimeistely ja mahdolliset pienet maalaustyöt

\* auton korin ja maalipinnan käsittely

\* autojen perustason huolto- ja korjaustyöt

\* moottorin ja auton teknisen toiminnan ymmärtäminen

\* auton vianmäärityksen avustavat tehtävät

\* moottorin toimintaan ja optimointiin liittyvien asioiden ymmärtäminen

\* muut autopesulan ja autokorjaamon päivittäiset tehtävät.

Edellytämme hakijalta:

\* aikaisempaa työkokemusta autoalalta

\* käytännön osaamista auton pesusta, puhdistuksesta ja kiillotuksesta

\* ymmärrystä autojen rakenteesta ja tekniikasta

\* huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

\* kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

\* hyvää motivaatiota oppia uusia työtehtäviä

\* valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia autoalan työtehtäviä.

Eduksi katsotaan erityisesti se, että hakijalla on kokemusta sekä autonhoidosta että autojen teknisistä korjaus- ja huoltotehtävistä. Arvostamme henkilöä, joka ymmärtää auton kokonaisuutena eikä ainoastaan autonpesua.

Työ on käytännönläheistä ja työtehtävät vaihtelevat asiakkaiden ja yrityksen tarpeiden mukaan. Sopiva henkilö voi osallistua myös yrityksen toiminnan kehittämiseen ja uusiin autoalan palveluihin.

Kielitaito: suomen kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Muu kielitaito ei ole este, mikäli hakijalla on tehtävään vaadittava ammatillinen osaaminen.

Työsuhde: kokoaikainen / määräaikainen tai toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde sovittavasta järjestelystä riippuen.

Haemme ennen kaikkea monipuolista autoalan ammattilaista, jolla on käytännön osaamista, työmoraalia ja halua kehittyä.

jobs.title: Keittiön vuoropäällikkö, Kulman Kuppila, Raisio, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
RAISIO

Myllyn kauppakeskuksessa sijaitseva Kulman Kuppila etsii tiimiinsä KEITTIÖN VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ!
Tehtävä on määräaikainen vuoden loppuun saakka. Työtä on 90 tuntia kolmessa viikossa. Aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

Keittiön vuoropäällikkönä varmistat, että arki rullaa sujuvasti ja toimit esimerkillisesti kaikissa työtehtävissä. Työ on monipuolista ja sisältää ruoan valmistusta buffetlounaan ja kahvilatuotteiden parissa, asiakaspalvelua sekä vuoron johtamista ja keittiön toiminnan organisointia. Työpäiväsi kuluvat pääosin keittiössä ja asiakaspalvelun parissa, ja johdat vuoroa omalla esimerkilläsi osallistumalla aktiivisesti käytännön työhön tiimisi rinnalla. Työtä tehdään arkisin ja viikonloppuisin vaihtelevissa vuoroissa kello 6.00–19.00 välillä.

Kulman Kuppilan valikoimasta löytyy herkkuja asiakkaiden päivän jokaiseen hetkeen aamupuurosta iltapalaan, maukasta kotiruokabuffettia ja maittavia kahvilatuotteita unohtamatta.

Millaista vuoropäällikköä etsimme?

Vuoropäällikkönä viet rohkeasti tiimiä eteenpäin kannustavalla otteella ja pidät arjen rullaamassa hyvällä organisointikyvyllä sekä oikeudenmukaisella johtamisella. Arvostamme innokkuutta kehittyä, vahvaa tiimihenkeä ja kykyä tuoda positiivista energiaa koko meidän mahtavaan porukkaan, myös kiireen keskellä. Odotamme hakijalta aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan tai kahvilan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä voimassa olevaa hygieniapassia. Eduksi katsomme alan koulutuksen sekä aiemman työkokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.

Vuoropäällikön palkka perustuu Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaan esihenkilöiden työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 15,06-16,34 €/h. Vuorotyössä lisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaamme, niin tarjoamme sinulle:
Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa

Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella

Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet


Jos tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 22.9.2026 mennessä! Olemme sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voi eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? Keittiöpäällikkö Sanna Puikkonen kertoo mielellään lisää. Sannan tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 10-17 numerosta 010 764 4483.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing for Living System Integration in Architecture
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Scope of the work

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.

The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.

We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:

  • Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing: exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.

  • Living Material Design and Biological Performance: developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.

The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co-supervision of student projects.

Focus Area and Research Project

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:

  • Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment

  • Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials

  • Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development

  • Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds

  • Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity

  • Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance

  • Fabrication and evaluation of full-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing or Living Material Design and Biological Performance, and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities. Interdisciplinary experience connecting these areas is particularly valued.

Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Documented interest and foundational knowledge in bioreceptive design, living system integration or related research areas

  • Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile and at working level for the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C#

  • For the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile: practical experience in computational design, toolpath generation and robotic 3D printing, together with an understanding of biological requirements relevant to design; experience developing porous geometries and printable mineral materials are particularly valued

  • For the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile: practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued

  • Hands-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively

Contact information

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk. For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit the website at www.create-sdu.com. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Find full information about how to apply as well as assessment and employment terms on our website!
