  • evidentiranje aktivnosti u aplikaciju i ispunjavanje dokumentacije prema interno propisanim procedurama

ŠTO NUDIMO I ŠTO MOŽETE OČEKIVATI OD NAS:

  • mentora pri uvođenju u posao
  • dodatna usavršavanja prema zahtjevima radnog mjesta
  • mogućnost napredovanja
  • nagrade za radne rezultate
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnica, dar za djecu)
  • naknadu za troškove prijevoza
  • osiguran topli obrok
  • osiguranu radnu odjeću i obuću
  • liječnički i sanitarni pregled na trošak poslodavca
  • plaćene dopuste za životna događanja kao što su sklapanje braka, rođenje djeteta, preseljenje i sl.
  • timski rad u ugodnom i dinamičnom radnom okruženju
  • rad u uspješnoj kompaniji, prepoznatljivog brenda i snažne tržišne pozicije
  • društveno odgovorno okruženje

    VI STE KANDIDAT ZA NAS AKO IMATE:

  • SSS (poželjan smjer: elektromehaničar / elektrotehničar / tehničar za električne strojeve s primijenjenim računalstvom / mehatroničar)
  • radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima (poželjno, ali nije uvjet)
  • osnovno znanje engleskog jezika
  • osnovno znanje rada na računalu (MS Office)
  • proaktivnost
  • sposobnost rada u timu
  • želju za učenjem i usavršavanjem
  • tveno odgovorno okruženje

jobs.title: AUTOELEKTRIČAR M/Ž
jobs.description:
Autoelektričarski poslovi. Rad na terenu u Hrvatskoj i zemljama EU, stimulativna primanja sukladno provedenim danima na terenu. Molimo zvati na mob: 091 1319 012 MARIJAN
  • Specijalističko obrazovanje: Obvezno posjedovanje diplome/uvjerenja o položenom specijalističkom ispitu za zvanje Elektrotehničar specijalista za autoelektriku.
  • Napredno poznavanje elektrosustava: Iskustvo u samostalnom servisiranju i remontu elektropokretača (alnsera) i pratećih elektrokretnih sustava na vozilima.
  • Tehnička stručnost: Sposobnost napredne dijagnostike i čitanja složenih elektrotehničkih shema sukladno četverogodišnjem elektrotehničkom obrazovanju.

jobs.title: SPREMAČ/SPREMAČICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 5) 1 spremač/ica - 40 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno radno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  • Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  • Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 5) 1 bidella - 40 ore settimanali di lavoro, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE:
  1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20);
  2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.).
Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. Oltre ai suddetti controlli saranno valutate delle qualifiche aggiuntive dalla Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni rispettando le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE Belvedere con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate da dati biografici (CV), da certificato di studio richiesto del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare, da certificato di cittadinanza, da estratto elettronico o certificato sui dati iscritti nelle evidenze matricolari dell’Ufficio di pensionamento croato e da attestato comprovante l’assenza di condanne penali la cui data di rilascio non deve risultare superiore ai sei (6) mesi. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tutta la documentazione deve essere presentata sotto forma di fotocopia semplice, mentre il candidato scelto deve presentare i documenti originali prima della firma del contrato di lavoro. I candidati i quali hanno diritto di precedenza secondo regolamenti speciali, devono dichiarare questo diritto e fornire prove che confermino il loro diritto e stato. I suddetti candidati avranno la precedenza di fronte agli altri candidati che hanno le stesse condizioni e qualifiche, ma non usufruiscono di codesto diritto. Il link del Ministero degli veterani: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf e https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Gli inviti per ogni fase della selezione, con il tempo e il posto dove si terranno, come anche i risultati di esse e anche i risultati finali saranno pubblicati sulle pagine web della scuola sul sito: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Se un candidato non si presenta a una delle fasi di selezione verrà considerato come se avesse ritirato la propria domanda. Secondo il GDPR i candidati con la presentazione della domanda acconsentono alla scuola di conservare e trattare i loro dati personali contenuti nella loro documentazione ai fini di codesto bando di concorso. Le domande devono pervenire al seguente indirizzo: OŠ-SE Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Fiume, entro 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso. Il presente Bando sarà pubblicato sulle pagine web della Scuola e dell’Ufficio di collocamento Croato il giorno 8 settembre 2026. Le domande incomplete, non firmate e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito, non saranno prese in considerazione

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA TJELESNE I ZDRAVSTVENE KULTURE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 3) 1 učitelj/ica tjelesne i zdravstvene kulture – 20 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno radno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 3) 1 insegnante di cultura fisico sanitaria – 20 ore settimanali, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE:
  1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20);
  2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.).
Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. Oltre ai suddetti controlli saranno valutate delle qualifiche aggiuntive dalla Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni rispettando le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE Belvedere con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate da dati biografici (CV), da certificato di studio richiesto del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare, da certificato di cittadinanza, da estratto elettronico o certificato sui dati iscritti nelle evidenze matricolari dell’Ufficio di pensionamento croato e da attestato comprovante l’assenza di condanne penali la cui data di rilascio non deve risultare superiore ai sei (6) mesi. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tutta la documentazione deve essere presentata sotto forma di fotocopia semplice, mentre il candidato scelto deve presentare i documenti originali prima della firma del contrato di lavoro. I candidati i quali hanno diritto di precedenza secondo regolamenti speciali, devono dichiarare questo diritto e fornire prove che confermino il loro diritto e stato. I suddetti candidati avranno la precedenza di fronte agli altri candidati che hanno le stesse condizioni e qualifiche, ma non usufruiscono di codesto diritto. jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 1) 2 učitelja/ice razredne nastave u produženom boravku – 40 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 1) 2 insegnanti di classe al doposcuola – 40 ore settimanali di lavoro, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE:
  1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20);
  2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.).
Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. Oltre ai suddetti controlli saranno valutate delle qualifiche aggiuntive dalla Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni rispettando le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE Belvedere con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate da dati biografici (CV), da certificato di studio richiesto del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare, da certificato di cittadinanza, da estratto elettronico o certificato sui dati iscritti nelle evidenze matricolari dell’Ufficio di pensionamento croato e da attestato comprovante l’assenza di condanne penali la cui data di rilascio non deve risultare superiore ai sei (6) mesi. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tutta la documentazione deve essere presentata sotto forma di fotocopia semplice, mentre il candidato scelto deve presentare i documenti originali prima della firma del contrato di lavoro. I candidati i quali hanno diritto di precedenza secondo regolamenti speciali, devono dichiarare questo diritto e fornire prove che confermino il loro diritto e stato. I suddetti candidati avranno la precedenza di fronte agli altri candidati che hanno le stesse condizioni e qualifiche, ma non usufruiscono di codesto diritto. Il link del Ministero degli veterani: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf e https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Gli inviti per ogni fase della selezione, con il tempo e il posto dove si terranno, come anche i risultati di esse e anche i risultati finali saranno pubblicati sulle pagine web della scuola sul sito: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Se un candidato non si presenta a una delle fasi di selezione verrà considerato come se avesse ritirato la propria domanda. Secondo il GDPR i candidati con la presentazione della domanda acconsentono alla scuola di conservare e trattare i loro dati personali contenuti nella loro documentazione ai fini di codesto bando di concorso. Le domande devono pervenire al seguente indirizzo: OŠ-SE Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Fiume, entro 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso. Il presente Bando sarà pubblicato sulle pagine web della Scuola e dell’Ufficio di collocamento Croato il giorno 8 settembre 2026. Le domande incomplete, non firmate e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito, non saranno prese in considerazione

jobs.title: KUĢUBŪVES ATSLĒDZNIEKS
jobs.description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību „Avimar”reģistrācijas numurs:  40203499514

AICINA DARBĀ KUĢUBŪVES ATSLĒDZNIEKUS (profesiju kods 7214 02)


Uzņēmuma darbības joma ir kuģu un peldošo iekārtu būve, kuģu un laivu remonts un apkope, kā arī metāla konstrukciju un to sastāvdaļu ražošana.

Pienākumi:

  • Veikt metāla konstrukciju remontu un izgatavošanu.
  • Veikt dažādu iekārtu un to mezglu montāžu, demontāžu, kā arī atjaunošanu.
  • Veikt aizzīmēšanas, ciršanas, griešanas, vīlēšanas, urbšanas, izrīvēšanas, pielāgošanas, kniedēšanas, liekšanas, presēšanas, slīpēšanas, taisnošanas, valcēšanas, lepēšanas un mērīšanas darbus.
  • Lasīt un izprast tehniskos rasējumus.
  • Ievērot darba aizsardzības un vides aizsardzības prasības.
  • Lietot un sekot līdzi atbilstošajai tehniskajai dokumentācijai.

Prasības:

  • Darba pieredze atbilstošā profesijā vismaz 3 gadi.
  • Bez kaitīgiem ieradumiem.
  • Izpratne par rasējumiem, iekārtām un tehnoloģisko dokumentāciju.
  • Prasme lietot un darbināt pacelšanas iekārtas (ja nepieciešams).
  • Izpratne par dažāda veida kuģu uzbūvi.
  • Prasme strādāt ar gāzes griešanas iekārtām un slīpmašīnām.
  • Spēja strādāt patstāvīgi un komandā.
  • Atbildīga attieksme pret darbu.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

Requirements

 - Currently based in Europe.

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

MAIN DUTIES: • Receive customers and obtain information about equipment faults. • Inspect and diagnose problems with laptops, desktops and computer components. • Diagnose and repair motherboards and electronic circuits at component level. • Use oscilloscopes, multimeters, microscopes and other testing equipment. • Analyse circuit diagrams, electrical signals, charging systems and power-management circuits. • Repair or replace faulty components, including screens, batteries, keyboards, connectors, storage devices and memory. • Perform soldering and motherboard rework. • Carry out electrical and load tests and confirm that equipment is working correctly after repair. • Review datasheets and select compatible replacement components. • Install or update BIOS, firmware, operating systems and drivers when required. • Build, configure and upgrade desktop computers. • Identify the causes of recurring faults and develop practical repair and testing procedures. • Explain diagnostic results, repair options and recommended upgrades to customers. • Maintain accurate records of diagnostics, repairs, components and test results. • Train and assist other technicians with advanced repairs and diagnostics. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: • Degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related area. • At least three years’ relevant experience in computer hardware or electronic repairs. • Experience with motherboard and component-level diagnostics. • Ability to use electronic testing and soldering equipment. • Knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, BIOS and firmware. • Good technical, problem-solving, communication and customer-service skills.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
jobs.description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Product Partnerships Manager, Consumer/SMB
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Product Partnerships Manager to own Replit's most important strategic partnerships end-to-end: from identifying the opportunity to shipping the outcome and measuring the impact.

This is a product-focused role where you will work with our consumer technology partners, such as Stripe, Shopify, Google, and the broader connector ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, ecosystem thinking, and deal execution. You'll need to be a serious Replit power user. You'll speak credibly with engineers. You'll negotiate with senior partner stakeholders. And you'll be the person accountable for turning ambiguous ecosystem opportunities into shipped product and business outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop a clear point of view on Replit's partner landscape and build a prioritized pipeline of high-leverage opportunities across consumer tooling, AI tooling, cloud and infrastructure, and payments technology partners.

 - Lead partner conversations from early exploration through joint product thesis, business case, commercial terms, launch plan, and post-launch iteration.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Partner Engineering, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to turn agreements into shipped outcomes.

 - Work directly with Partner Engineers to scope integrations, demos, prototypes, reference apps, and partner enablement assets.

 - Define success metrics before every launch activation: retained usage, apps created, deployments, revenue, partner-sourced users, and use them to decide when to scale, iterate, or sunset a partnership.

 - Build lightweight operating systems: partner scorecards, launch checklists, partner roadmap tracking, and repeatable frameworks for evaluating new opportunities.

 - Represent the partner internally with strong product judgment; inform roadmap changes only when they create clear leverage for Replit users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're probably one of these:

 - A product partnerships or BD person from a developer platform, AI platform, API company, cloud platform, or builder tool.

 - A former PM or founder who can sell and negotiate externally while staying close to the product.

 - A technical ecosystem operator who has shipped integrations, partner programs, or AI-native workflows.

In all cases, you're a builder. You can open Replit and put together a credible demo. You're not expected to write production integration code but you need enough technical depth to scope the work, ask the right questions, and earn trust with engineers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and launching strategic partnerships.

 - Strong product judgment: you can explain why a partnership should or shouldn't influence the roadmap.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, auth, cloud and deployment, databases, LLMs, agents, and developer workflows.

 - Hands-on familiarity with Replit or comparable AI-native developer tools; ability to build credible demos and prototypes.

 - Ability to run an ambiguous, multi-party process from discovery through signed agreement, launch, and measurement.

 - Credibility with both senior external partners and internal engineers.

 - Strong written and verbal communication.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Background in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, API companies, or creative/productivity software.

 - Experience with MCP-style integrations, agent workflows, or AI model/tooling ecosystems.

 - Founder, PM, DevRel, solutions engineering, or technical BD background



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Manager -London
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.

You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders.

The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance.

You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA.

 - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development.

 - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover.

 - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion.

 - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows.

 - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization.

 - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership.

 - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities.

 - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions.

 - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices.



SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.

 - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery.

 - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams.

 - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions.

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems.

 - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans.

 - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments.

 - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders.

 - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs.
   
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment.

 - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows.

 - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration.

 - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling.

 - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs.

 - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts.

 - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up.

 - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions.
   

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.

jobs.title: Postdoc Position in Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute, The University of Southern Denmark in Sønderborg, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a postdoctoral research associate in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and (Photo)electrochemistry, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, a part of MCI, and it is integrated into the novel, active working group CatMatX, a research laboratory focused on developing next-generation catalytic materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications,  by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing project proposals to support research at SDU NanoSYD. 

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, and evaluation of materials performance in solar water splitting;

  • Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.;

  • Publishing of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals with high impact factors.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics; 

  • Assistance in teaching activities; 

  • Assistance in setting up the research infrastructure;

  • Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding. 

Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, Electrochemistry, or related fields; 

  • Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds;

  • Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM);   

  • Proven track record of publishing in international peer-reviewed scientific journals as leading author;

  • Fluency in English (both spoken and written);

  • Ability to work in teams and also independently; 

  • Strong communication skills; 

  • Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry. 

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities, DFT calculations and MD simulations;

  • Research experience in electrochemistry and solar water splitting; 

  • Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project; 

  • Proven record in participating in national and international research projects;

  • Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group.

Contact information

For more information about the department and the position, please contact Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk) and Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and it starts on 01.03.2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

To qualify for the position as postdoc you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s previous research work and experience most relevant to the offered position.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Certificates/Diplomas (Bachelor, Master, and PhD degrees) – Danish and/or English transcripts. 

  • Complete list of publications (please highlight publications most relevant to the offered position).

  • Research statement on developing novel transition metal-based mixed anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting.

  • A reference letter may be submitted, but is not required. 

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is October 31, 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST).

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
jobs.description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.
